articles.title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
articles.content: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: ViRA:通过跨输入相对政策优化实现超高分辨率视觉代理
articles.content_zh: 视觉特工通过放大到相关区域来回答关于超高分辨率相片的问题. 然而,现有的代理人往往从常识来回答而不是阅读证据. 在最终答案上的强化学习(RL)无法纠正这一点,因为猜测得到的奖励与阅读相同. 我们提出交叉输入相对政策优化(CrossRPO),对代理商进行对比集的培训. 一个对比集问了一个问题,一个图像的几个版本只与证据相去甚远,并且有不同的答案,所以只有读取证据才能解决整个集合. CrossRPO奖励解决整个集,我们证明它并没有强化一个集从常识中解答. 我们通过编辑21到120兆像素图像中的一个小物体来建立训练(VIRA-Train)和评价(VIRA-Bench)的对比集,我们用真实变化(VIRA-Bench-Real)进一步拍摄集,以排除编辑痕迹. 我们培训了两个视觉理性代理人,即VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B,其中CrossRPO只负责大约3500件VIRA-Train. CrossRPO在VIRA-Bench上达到63.3%的设定精度最高分辨率,而GRPO则为59.3%. VIRA-9B是其大小在所有基准上最准确的开放模型,而VIRA-27B的表现优于克洛德·海库·5.5和GPT-6-Luna,两者都处于最高思维水平,在大多数基准上都是如此.

articles.title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection
articles.content: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FaceJev: 面对面伪造检测的直接视觉决定
articles.content_zh: 伪造相貌的侦测方法往往在所见的操纵下表现良好,但被概括到不为人所见。 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以识别面部部分并评估其视觉可信度. 现有的基于MLLM的方法通常通过文字解释来表达这些判断,但很少将个别部分的决定作为明确的学习目标来对待. 我们介绍FaceJev,一种基于MLLM的方法,通过直接的视觉判断来检测假相. 遵循Jev配方,FaceJev用共享的图像编码解答了8个关于面部部分的独立问题,并读取了从原生的答案日志中得出的异常概率. 如果任何部分被预测为异常,一面被归类为伪造,直接将检测结果与部分决定联系起来. 我们构建了Pat Forensics, 一个大约160克图像的数据集, 并有八个面部的二进制异常目标, 监督这些决定。 我们进一步提议FS-GRPO,它通过精确的奖励与其备选方法进行比较,利用检测和部分奖励来优化每个部分的决定。 FaceJev在隐形操纵上比最强的基线业绩高出7.25个百分点. 广泛的消化研究验证了我们的设计选择和主要组成部分的有效性。

articles.title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
articles.content: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

articles.title_zh: VLMs计划如何 什么是下一个
articles.content_zh: 当一个视觉语言模型描述一个图像时,它一次命名一个物体,很少重复自己,然而模型是如何规划这个顺序的远不明显. 我们描述一个甚高频用于在它看起来之前决定向何处看的机制。 该机制有四个主要部分。 首先,绑定头会将相关的文本符号与图像相匹配,并将其解为指向匹配图像区域的指针. 第二,相同的绑定头将每个书面答复绑在它来自的区域,模型将它变成进步信号:光标,列表被写入的图像中的位置. 第三,选定步骤选择光标后最近的未写区域,或停止。 最后,凝视头执行所选择的指针并返回一个在那里所绘制的概念,哪个语言头和后期的MLP会变成问题语言中的一个单词. 我们在合成视觉检索任务上通过Qune3-VL模型中的因果补丁验证这个机制的每个部分,并对照其他假设来测试我们的机制. 我们进一步显示,这一机制具有各种输入格式、自然照片和语言,其约束、中继和凝视头出现在2B至32B的每个模型大小上。 这部作品使我们能够调查一个VLM如何将一个问题和图像变成一个答案的序列,逐层地层地层地层地层地物地物地物地物地. 更广泛地说,它为研究模型如何规划长期推出的复杂多步骤任务开辟了道路。 我们的项目可查阅https://plan.baulab.info/。

articles.title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
articles.content: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

articles.title_zh: 当历史学基础模型需要几何 试验时间增强?
articles.content_zh: 测试-时间增强(TTA)聚合模型预测在推论期间对一个输入的多处转变视图进行. 由于神道影像缺乏犬目取向,$D_4$ TTA——跨越8个旋转和平方反射——是计算病理的标准默认. 然而,自我监督的神学基础模型(FMs)以内在的自转性变化而兴起,令人怀疑它的持续效用. 我们以9个神学调频和6个通用模型为基准,跨越4个补丁级和2个全滑行图像数据集。 我们发现,4美元TTA仍然是可靠的临时改进,但收益从普通用途骨干单位的1.98美元百分点(pp)减少到TCGA-UT的常年调频单位的0.50美元,最大的型号则进一步收缩。 为了消除计算间接费用,我们的实验表明,有选择地将Entrophy routing -- -- 用于不确定的预测 -- -- 回收大部分收益,同时只增加13美元样本。 最后,我们显示补丁级TTA的改进不会转移到幻灯片级多实例学习(MIL). 代码:https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta 页面存档备份,存于互联网档案馆.

articles.title: Wildfire-SSR: Geolocation-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Structure-Level Wildfire Risk Assessment
articles.content: Structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment is critical for reducing losses in wildland-urban interface communities, yet existing methods often fail to combine parcel-scale ignition pathways with community-scale geographic coverage. This study introduces Wildfire-SSR (Satellite and Street-view for wildfire Risk), a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence. A Vision-Language Model extracts wildfire-relevant building and site attributes from pre-event street-view panoramas and converts them into structured semantic text. These features are spatially aligned with satellite imagery through a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder, while a frozen satellite-pretrained DINOv3 encoder captures overhead visual context. Alternative geolocation embedding strategies are evaluated to anchor text-derived features within each satellite patch. The framework is tested on approximately 37,000 structures affected by the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, using wildfire risk labels derived from relative post-event damage patterns to better represent inherent structural vulnerability. Rotary Positional Embedding provides the strongest spatial grounding, achieving a building localization F1 score of 0.6735 and a harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for five-class pixel-level risk classification, outperforming unimodal baselines and an unanchored multimodal configuration. The model also shows a conservative bias in higher-risk classes, reducing severe-risk underestimation, and completes end-to-end assessment of the study area in 37 minutes on a single GPU. Wildfire-SSR reframes cross-view fusion as localized semantic alignment and provides a scalable tool for mitigation prioritization, resilience planning, and insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment.

articles.title_zh: 野火 -- -- SSR:地理定位 -- -- 智能多式组合结构 -- -- 一级野火风险评估
articles.content_zh: 结构层面的野火脆弱性评估对于减少野地-城市界面社区的损失至关重要,但现有方法往往未能将地块规模的点火路径同社区范围的地理覆盖结合起来。 本研究引入了Wildfire-SSR(Satellite and Street-view for Wirdfire Risk),这是一个地缘感-多模式框架,将宏观规模的卫星环境与微观规模的街景证据相融合. 一个Vision-Language Model从事前街景全景中提取出与野火相关的建筑和站点属性,并把它们转换成结构化的语义文本. 这些特征通过解接的相通聚变码器在空间上与卫星图像相配合,而被冷冻的卫星前置的DINOv3编码器则能捕捉起伏的视觉上下文. 评价其他地理定位嵌入战略,将文本生成的特征固定在每个卫星上。 该框架在洛杉矶受2025年伊通和帕利萨德斯大火影响的约37 000个结构上进行了测试,使用相对事件后破坏模式产生的野火风险标签来更好地代表固有的结构脆弱性。 旋转姿势 嵌入提供了最强的空间地平面,实现了建筑本地化F1分0.6735分,并实现了五等象素级风险分级的谐波平均分F1分0.2476分,性能优异的单式基线和无预设的多式配置. 该模型还显示在高风险类别中存在保守偏好,减少了重度风险低估,并在单个GPU上以37分钟完成对研究区的端到端评估. Wildfire-SSR将交叉视角聚变重新设定为局部语义结合,并为缓解优先排序、复原力规划和以保险为导向的野火风险评估提供了一个可扩展的工具。

articles.title: Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction
articles.content: Long video generation should keep the subject and background consistent while supporting rich, natural motion. However, autoregressive models are often distilled with distribution matching distillation (DMD) over short windows, which does not train them to keep this consistency over long ranges. As a result, the subject and background can drift over time. Methods that manage the key-value (KV) cache retain or retrieve history to reduce drift. Yet this history may itself have drifted. We propose Reference Forcing, which uses the initial frames as an appearance reference. We first build a teacher that uses attention masks to force each region of a new frame to attend to the same region in the initial frames. The teacher finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation models. We then distill this behavior into a separate attention path of the student, which needs no external models at inference. We further introduce value correction, which corrects drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of drift-free initial frames. Experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency among long-video methods on different base models, and its advantage grows with video length. Ablations show both components are needed to gain consistency without losing motion. More visualizations and code are available at https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 参考 强制: 长视频生成与区域引导漂流修正
articles.content_zh: 长视频生成应保持主题和背景的一致性,同时支持丰富的自然运动. 然而,自递式模型往往会被分泌相匹配的蒸馏(DMD)于短窗上分泌而分泌出,这并不能训练它们将这种一致性长期地保持下去. 因此,主题和背景可以随时间而漂移. 用于管理密钥值缓存的方法保留或检索历史以减少漂移. 然而,这一历史本身可能已经漂移。 我们建议使用初始框架作为外观参考。 我们首先建立一个教师,使用注意口罩强迫每个区域用新框架在初始框架中照顾同一个区域。 教师发现这些地区有现成的分化模型。 然后我们把这个行为分解成学生的单独关注路径,这不需要外部模型来推断. 我们进一步引入数值校正,将KV缓存中漂移的值校正到无漂移初始帧的匹配值. 实验显示"参考 Forcing"在不同的基础模型上实现了最先进的主题和长视频方法的背景一致性,其优势随着视频长度的增长而增长. 分解显示两个组件都需要在不失去运动的情况下获得一致性. 在https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/Reference-force/上可找到更多的可视化和编码。

articles.title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
articles.content: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BLIP-Live:在主动流线视频代理中平衡及时性和射击精度
articles.content_zh: 对现实世界互动系统而言,视频的流畅理解越来越重要。 这种系统必须积极主动地进行自然和有益的人类互动:一旦获得足够的证据,它们就应立即作出反应,同时避免过早、重复或不正确的反应。 我们提出《BLIP-Live》,这是一个统一数据、衡量标准、利用和培训的框架,围绕的是共同制定积极性,作为有效的因果反应决定,平衡两个相互竞争的目标,即对沉默作出反应。 首先,我们构建了BLIP-Live-780K数据集,包含人类对主动反应内容和时间的说明,它定义了这种所期望的行为. 然后,我们提议PAUC-F, 一个衡量我们所期望的主动行为的标准。 PAUC-F结合了现有的反应及时性测量和射击精度来奖励早期有用的反应而不会奖励过度射击. 随着我们所期望的行为的界定和可测量,我们最终调查了模型-不可知推论利用,这些推论引出线下视觉语言模型(VLM)的主动流出能力,以及学习进一步提高其主动反应能力的培训管道. 在这两种情况下,我们发现滑动的视觉窗口、在线互动内存和结构化的响应产出的组合,始终产生最强的主动性。 我们的实验产生了两个模型,我们的BLIP-Live-Quen模型在四个主动的流线基准中实现了最先进的性能,其收益比基线最高可达44%,超过多个封闭的API模型。 我们的代码和数据将公开发布。

articles.title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 见但未说:视野-语言模型中跨图像的定位和修复比较
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)往往无法在两个图像上匹配一个点或一个对象,即使答案可以从自己的隐藏状态解码. 我们从视觉符号追踪到答题字母的这个失败,在Qune3-VL(2B-32B),InternVL3.5-8B,和Gemma-3-12B中,关于合成形状相匹配,同心点相通(HPatches),和语义相通(SPair-71k),并找到两个截然不同的出题点,一组带比较的注意头,以及一个能触及0.02%参数的修复. 两个出错点: 准确的拷贝被比较,但没有被读出. 答案-位置探测器在每一个家族中都超过了被校正的输出15到25分,因为可名和不可名的形状相同,沿着探测器的方向向下行走的答案不超过随机方向. 语义上的信件在视觉符号中存在,但从未到达答案. 一条途径:将16-32个头的交叉图像注意力再分配,并保留其质量,取出17-22分的合成精度和15-32分的HPatches精度,对随机或注意相匹配的头最多取出7分. 训练本身发现的杠杆:只有这些头的查询和关键预测才能使SPair-71k的精度提高28.3分(Qune3-VL-8B)和25.1分(InternVL3.5-8B),击败了两层相配和注意力相配的头,并转至HPatches和BLINK. 一个不受约束的全层适配器通过相同头部的注意途径其收益的21-51%,随机头部最多为7%,通过改变其读取内容(效果的83-86%)而不是其重量来完成. 每个决定规则在运行前被冻结,每个被报告的数字由独立核查脚本重编.

articles.title: How Much Does Saliency Accuracy Matter for Saliency-Guided 360-degree Image Compression?
articles.content: Saliency-guided coding allocates bits to the regions viewers are most likely to attend, but accurate 360-degree saliency prediction is computationally expensive, an obstacle for low-latency immersive streaming applications such as robot teleoperation. We quantify how much saliency-prediction accuracy actually translates into compression gain. Building on a saliency-guided rate-distortion-optimized (RDO) learned codec, modified so that the training-time latent mask is driven by ground-truth saliency, which yields a single, predictor-agnostic codec, we evaluate saliency predictors spanning two orders of magnitude in compute on both the learned codec and H.265/HEVC. The results show that higher saliency-prediction accuracy yields diminishing compression gains: a lightweight predictor fast enough for live use (52 frames per second) captures 65% of the ground-truth oracle's bit-rate saving, a 3.3x heavier one reaches 74%, and a further 38x increase in compute adds no measurable benefit, on either codec. Therefore, lightweight predictors might also be a practical choice for latency-constrained 360-degree streaming.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 光度精确度对光度 360度图像压缩有多重要?
articles.content_zh: Saliency-guided Coding将比特分配给各地区的观众最有可能参加,但准确的360度显要预测在计算上费用高昂,这是机器人远程操作等低纬度浸流应用的障碍. 我们量化了多少 显著的预测精度 实际转化为压缩增益。 借助于一个具有显著性的、指导性的比率扭曲-优化(RDO)的已学习的编码器,经过修改后,训练时间潜入口罩由地面-真实性驱动,产生一个单一的预测-不可知性编码器,我们评价跨越两个数量级的已学习的编码器和H.265/HEVC的显著预测器。 结果显示,更高的显性能预测精度会产生不断减少的压缩增益:一个能活用(52帧每秒)的轻量级预测器能捕捉到地真甲骨骼比特率节省的65%,一个3.3x重到74%,再加38x的计算不会增加可测量的效益,无论是在两个编码器上. 因此,轻量级预测器也可能是耐久性受限制的360度相流的一个实际选择.

articles.title: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
articles.content: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DuoFlow: 与精细控制同步演讲和动作生成
articles.content_zh: 一个被体现的发言者的表达性不仅取决于所说的话,还取决于声音的声音和身体的移动方式. 然而,现有的联合语音-动作生成模型大多被语义或中间语音表达所暗示地所驱动,对运动层次,身体部位,或相声风格几乎没有明显的控制. 为了弥补这一差距,我们构建了MotionSpeech,这是可控联合语音-动作生成的有条理的基准,包括文字记录、语音式描述和两个层次的运动条件。 在这个基准的基础上,我们提出DuoFlow,一种双流潜流变压器,在共同噪声水平下联合去声和运动,以及统一的二基时间坐标. 针对模式的剩余连接器将结构化的条件注入相应的流中,分层双向双模式的注意协调其生成,单调的电话线路将正常的进度锚与CTC监督结合起来,以加强语音时间模型的制作。 DuoFlow为精细分泌的动作和相声式控制提供了统一的界面,并展示了合成高质量,同步,与指令相协调的语音-相声相声序列的能力.

articles.title: GHySSeg: Real-Time Geometric Ground and Road Segmentation for Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR
articles.content: Hybrid solid-state LiDAR sensors are making their way into production vehicles, yet the data they produce differs structurally from that of the established spinning mechanical sensors behind today's autonomous-driving datasets: it is ring-free, dense, cluttered, and concentrated in a frontal field of view. The classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for drivable space computation and navigation assume the ordered ring-and-column structure of a 360-degree spinning LiDAR and degrade or fail on this data, while learned alternatives are computationally heavy, hard to certify, and trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR data. We demonstrate that the same dense, per-curve geometry is instead an opportunity to close the divide between the industry's preferred sensors and autonomous-driving research. We present GHySSeg, a purely geometric method that segments ground and drivable road from a single hybrid solid-state LiDAR frame by tracing each scan curve and reading two geometric signatures, a step in height and a fold-back in range, with no training and no graphics processing unit. To evaluate it, we release HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, comprising 100 manually labeled and 7000 unlabeled frames recorded by two vehicles in real driving. On this benchmark, GHySSeg surpasses both geometric and learned state-of-the-art baselines across ground and road segmentation, reaching an intersection-over-union of 0.907 for road and 0.896 for ground at over 0.96 precision, while running in real time at about 22 milliseconds per frame on a single core.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GHySSeg:混合固态LiDAR实时几何地平面和路平面
articles.content_zh: 混合固态LiDAR传感器正在进入生产载体,然而它们所产生的数据在结构上与今天自主驾驶数据集背后的既有旋转机械传感器不同:它是无环状的,密集的,杂乱无章的,并集中在前视场. 自主飞行器在可驾驶空间计算和导航时所依赖的经典几何方法假设360度旋转LiDAR所订购的环相并列结构,并在此数据上降解或失败,而所学的替代品则在计算上很重,难以验证,并且几乎专门对旋转-LiDAR数据进行培训. 我们证明,同样的密密的每曲线几何是缩小该行业偏好传感器与自主驾驶研究之间鸿沟的机会。 我们提出的GHySSeg是一种纯粹的几何方法,它通过追踪每个扫描曲线并读取两个几何特征,高一阶和折叠回放范围,从单一混合固态LiDAR框架分出地面和可驾驶的道路,没有训练,也没有图形处理单元. 为了评价它,我们发布了HySoLiD-Drive,这是第一个在汽车混合固态LiDAR上专门用于地上和地上分道扬镳的公共基准,包括100个手动标注和7000个无标注框被两辆车记录在真实驾驶中. 在这个基准上,GHySSeg超越了地上和地上分道通航的几何和最先进的基线,达到0.907路和0.896路相接,精确度超过0.96分,同时在一个单一地心上实时运行,每帧约22毫秒.

articles.title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
articles.content: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在大厅道上失落:将持续空间记忆设定为整个审查的基准
articles.content_zh: 持续的空间理解对于内含物剂在它们反复遇到的环境中可靠地运作至关重要。 它要求承认重新审视的地方,尽管观点发生了变化,将它们与相类似的房间区分开来,并随着环境的变化而更新记忆。 然而,现有的评价往往在分开的访问中隐含着实际地点的身份。 我们引入了ReSpace Bench, 一个包含3,244个问题的基准, 涵盖590个合成场景和真实家庭场景, 分成9个任务, 跨越房间协会,持续状态跟踪, 以及下游推理。 受控行走通过物理入室来定义访问,并刻意包括同类型的房间分心器和交叉会话对象变化. 我们对32个模型和3个代理视频理解框架的评价揭示出巨大的局限性:最强的被评价的零镜头模型达到总精度50.5%,450个问题子集的精度为52.2%,而人类注释者则为90.1%。 所评价的代理框架与同一基准模型的直接推论相比没有总体改进。 对代理行刑痕迹的分析显示有证据遗漏和不正确的交叉访问室关联是重大故障模式,这表明单独寻找的迭接证据并不能确保空间内存的一致性. 进一步的分析揭示了认识熟悉的房间和确定正确访问的房间之间的差距,同时以注释为指南的取样突出了保持干预访问和过渡的重要性。 我们还提供RS-30K,这是从合成源中分离的训练数据集,没有模板,场景,路线,或视频与基准重叠. 微调出Qwen3-VL-8B将整体精度从35.5%提升到60.4%,其中关联度和改良度最大的收益扩展到了现实情景.

articles.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
articles.content: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Lynn Real-Hand:与手控解锁世界互动
articles.content_zh: 交互式视频世界模型通过文本和相机控制使探索成为可能,而直接对象交互则需要更精细的控制. 手提供了自然界面,但将连续的手动转化为连贯的视觉反应仍然具有挑战性,因为手-物体动态复杂并需要实时计算. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了Lynn Real-Hand,这是一种手控视频世界模型,它统一了与高效流体生成的精确互动模型. 我们控制了100K的相互作用片段,这些片段跨越不同的真实和合成环境,并发展手感监督,以改善精细的手动和物体相互作用。 在此基础上,我们学习了几步生成的因果流图,并引入了区域-意识分数分馏法,结合了互补的视频和图像前作来完善互动动态和视觉外观. 为了进一步减少推论延迟,我们提议使用Ultra-Fast-VAE,这是一个紧凑的视频解码器,它保持了高的重建忠诚度并大大降低计算成本。 与现有方法相比,对Hand Bench进行的广泛评价显示,手跟脚的准确性和视觉质量更高。 我们的全序模型实现了181.67分的FVD和93.02分的MANO Dice分数,而三步因果模型保持了MANO Dice分数92.49分. 对于实时互动,单H200上流的540p会达到18.03个FPS并有741ms的耐久性,最优化的峰值GPU记忆足迹只有34.89GB. 我们将发布数据集,模型权重,以及完整的培训和推断代码,以支持手控视频世界模型的研究.

articles.title: Event-Triggered Visual Perception for Real-Time Harvest Outcome Estimation in Mechanical Blueberry Harvesting
articles.content: Mechanical blueberry harvesting requires a balance between removing ripe fruit and avoiding premature removal of unripe berries that could remain on the bush for a later harvest. However, operators generally lack real-time information about the maturity composition of the fruit being collected. This study develops an event-triggered machine-vision system that measures the maturity of harvested blueberries directly on the harvester. When a filled crate is moved by the machine, an RGB image is automatically captured and analysed using a three-class detector that identifies ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe berries. The system operates locally on the existing CPU-only industrial computer and therefore requires neither continuous image processing nor dedicated GPU hardware. During field testing, 79 crate images containing 48,634 visible blueberries in manually verified reference annotations were evaluated. The vision system estimated an overall ripe-fruit fraction of 90.22%, compared with 90.97% determined manually. Per-image ripe-fruit estimates showed a mean absolute error of 0.935 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of r=0.967. Maturity estimates remained similar between the two sides of the harvester for which the light conditions varied despite poorer absolute counting performance under direct sunlight. All field events were processed within the available 14 s per-side crate interval. The proposed approach provides a practical means of quantifying one component of harvest selectivity while the machine is operating. Such information could support operator decision-making and, when combined with measurements of fruit recovery and losses, contribute to future feedback-based control of mechanical harvesting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对机械蓝莓收割结果的估计
articles.content_zh: 机械取出蓝莓需要平衡兼顾取出成熟水果和避免过早取出可留入灌木丛后再取出未成熟的浆果。 然而,操作者一般缺乏关于所收集的水果成熟度成分的实时信息. 本研究开发出一种事件触发机视系统,直接在收割机上测量所收获蓝莓的成熟度. 当一个装满了的箱子被机器移动时,一个RGB图像会自动被捕获,并使用三等探测器进行分析,这种探测器可以识别出成熟的,半圆形的,和不圆形的浆果. 该系统在现有的只使用CPU的工业计算机上局部运行,因此既不需要连续的图像处理,也不需要专门的GPU硬件. 在现场测试中,对79个箱型图像进行了评估,这些图像在人工核实的参考说明中包含48 634个可见蓝莓。 视力系统估计总的成熟水果分数为90.22%,而人工确定的成熟水果分数为90.97%。 每幅图像成熟果实的估计数显示,平均绝对误差为0.935个百分点,而皮尔逊的相关误差为0.967. 收割机两侧的成熟度估计仍然相近,尽管在直接阳光下绝对计数性能较差,但光线条件却各不相同。 所有外地活动都是在14个每箱间隔内处理的。 拟议办法为在机器运行期间量化收获选择的一个部分提供了实用手段。 此类信息可以支持经营者的决策,如果与对水果回收和损失的测量相结合,有助于今后对机械收割的反馈控制。

articles.title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
articles.content: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效率的微升微升的平衡双重系数化
articles.content_zh: 重量因数化(WF)方法旨在降低模型的耐久性,内存,或两者兼而有之. 这些通常会将一个被预先训练的模型分解成两个或两个以上的因子,这些因子以较少的参数和浮点操作(FLOPs)来取来相近的原始模型权重. 然而,将较少的FLOP转化为降低耐用性在实践中对WF方法具有挑战性,因为采用的管理费用是用多个较小的矩阵取代一个大的权重矩阵。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议平衡双重系数化(BTWF),它利用因素化模型的独特结构同时降低延迟并增强学习能力. 具体来说,BTWF是在共同基础的WF设置下运行的,其中两层或多层被分解成一个共享的基础矩阵和一个分层的混合矩阵. 如果这些共享层有相同的输入(即为双胞胎),那么我们只需要执行一次共享前传,减少推论时间. 然而,双层往往大小不一,从前作中的方法往往倾向于更上一层. 相比之下,我们的方法通过将“要素平衡”(FCB)与“组合贡献平衡”(BCB)相结合,提高了绩效,“要素平衡”(FCB)确保每个共同成员在选定的因素中都有充分的代表性,而“组合贡献平衡”(BCB)则考虑下游模型效应。 此外,我们还表明,过度计量的BTWF,即某些层次的因素导致FLOP高于培训期间的原始水平,可以在试验时不增加资源的情况下提高任务绩效。 对9个基准的6个模型进行的实验表明,BTWF在计算成本相当的情况下,没有进行昂贵的微调(1-3.5%的增益),就能取得2%-6%的先进收益。

articles.title: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
articles.content: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Contracted Visual Latents 在超高分辨率遥感中保留本地证据
articles.content_zh: 超高分辨率遥感场面的提问回答对多式大型语言模型造成紧张:全球概览模糊了小物体和当地属性,而详细的作物消耗了大量环境。 将所检查的作物压缩成连续视觉潜伏物的短序,一旦作物标志物被丢弃,就会产生紧凑的内存,然而,对自然图像的诊断研究发现,模型往往忽略了潜伏的内容,使紧凑的潜伏物能否保留被俯冲的UHR遥感场景所损失的精细目标还不清楚。 为了将证据保留从区域选择中分离出来,我们将高分辨率作物编码为被冻结的骨干的潜在记忆符号并评价其预测效用和内容依赖性。 在LRS-GRO上的两代Quen-VL中,64位存储器对所保留的作物标志物进行了7.6-9.9倍的压缩,使仅被下取样的全球图像的精度提高了2.5-4.8个百分点,通过XLRS-Bench上一致的行为恢复了大部分高分辨率作物收益. 取而代之的是同一场景的另一个图像或另一个区域的内存,将精度降低5.8至7.4个百分点并产生比完全去除内存更低的精度,表明预测依赖于编码的区域证据. 在同一型号内恢复源收成会减少由去除或去除内存而导致的精度损失. 这些结论确定,紧凑的可视性潜力在UHR遥感中保留了有益的当地证据,并确定证据的提供是决定其贡献的关键因素。

articles.title: [CLS] and [EOS] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
articles.content: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to empower models to continuously acquire new knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. With the advent of vision-language models like CLIP, leveraging their cross-modal alignment capabilities to address CIL challenges has emerged as a dominant paradigm. Existing methods leverage CLIP's global representations (i.e., the visual [CLS] token and the textual [EOS] token) for cross-modal alignment. While achieving effective classification, they overlook the rich patch-level visual features and token-level textual semantics inherent in CLIP. For example, the [CLS] token aggregates local information to capture the general concept of "cat", while the patch-level details retain specific localized features essential for recognition, such as the tail, fur, and face. We propose PACE (PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement) to uncover the long-neglected local representations within CLIP. First, based on the global representations like [CLS] token and [EOS] token, we identify the top-k most crucial visual patches and textual tokens. Subsequently, to better utilize the extracted key local features, we design a cross-modal fusion module. This module leverages local textual semantics to refine visual representations, while augmenting textual semantics with local visual features. As the fusion module is shared across all tasks, directly fine-tuning it on new tasks would interfere with the knowledge learned from previous tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To alleviate this, we employ a projection-based update strategy to effectively preserve the critical parameter space of previous tasks during the adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple CIL benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: [CLS]和[EOS]托肯斯不足以进行基于CLIP的班级-增量学习
articles.content_zh: 班级强化学习(CIL)旨在增强模型的能力,以不断获得新知识,同时减轻灾难性的遗忘. 随着像CLIP这样的愿景语言模式的出现,利用其跨模式的对接能力来应对CIL挑战已成为主导范例. 现有方法利用CLIP的全球表示(即视觉[CLS]符号和文字[EOS]符号)来进行跨模式对接. 在实现有效分类的同时,它们忽略了CLIP中固有的丰富的补丁级视觉特征和符号级文字语义. 例如,[CLS]令牌汇总了本地信息来捕捉"猫"的一般概念,而补丁级细节则保留了识别所必需的特定局部特征,如尾巴,毛皮,和相貌等. 我们建议PACE(Patch-token Cross-Model-Administration)在CLIP中找出长期被忽视的地方代表. 首先,根据全球的表示,如[CLS]符和[EOS]符,我们确定最关键的视觉补丁和文字符. 之后,为了更好地利用提取出的关键局部特征,我们设计出一个跨模式聚变模块. 这个模块利用了本地文字语义来完善视觉表现,同时用本地视觉特征来扩充文字语义. 由于聚变模块是在所有任务中共享的,直接调整其新任务会干扰从以前任务中获取的知识,导致灾难性的遗忘. 为了缓解这种情况,我们采用了基于预测的更新战略,以有效保留适应新任务期间以往任务的关键参数空间。 广泛的实验表明,PACE在多种CIL基准方面大大超过最先进的方法。

articles.title: Power Line Detection in Point Clouds with Point-SAM and RANSAC
articles.content: This article deals with the problem of detecting the position of power lines in airborne laser scanning point clouds. We address both the problem of segmenting power lines from background like ground and vegetation and of identifying individual lines. For segmentation we compare a rule-based approach with one based on transfer learning (Point-SAM). For individual line detection, we derive the mathematical formulas for RANSAC applied to 3D catenaries and compare it with a non-parametric method (TriplClust). All methods are evaluated on a newly created dataset "PowLiDFR", which we make publicly available. The samples have been taken from the French project LiDAR HD and cover a variety of terrain layouts and point cloud resolutions. On this dataset, an unsupervised transfer learning outperformed a mere rule-based segmentation, and for individual power line detection, RANSAC was better in following the shape of catenaries than the non-parametric algorithm.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 带点SAM和RANSAC的点云中的电线检测
articles.content_zh: 本条涉及在空中激光扫描点云中探测动力线位置的问题. 我们既处理从地面和植被等背景分出电线的问题,也处理确定个别电线的问题。 就分类而言,我们比较了基于规则的方法和基于转移学习的方法(Point-SAM)。 对于单个行检测,我们得出了RANSAC应用于3D计数器的数学公式,并将其与非参数法(TriplClust)作比较. 所有方法均在新创建的"PowLiDFR"数据集上评价,我们公布. 取自法国项目"LiDAR HD"并涵盖各种地形布局和点云分辨率. 在这个数据集上,一个无监督的转移学习表现超过了单纯的基于规则的分解,对于单个的动力线检测,RANSAC比起非参数算法更能跟踪活计的形状.

articles.title: Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation
articles.content: Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4] relative to averaging and by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r <= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视频心脏率和呼吸率融合的质量和相似性指标:受控评价
articles.content_zh: 基于相机的心率(HR)和呼吸率(RR)估计值在可靠性上因出窗而异,一种常见的补救措施是将几种取出方法从无参考信号质量指标中以权重相接而成. 然而,很少有研究测试这些指标是在每个窗口中找出最准确的方法,还是超越了更简单的聚变. 我们评价了四个公共数据集(75个测试对象)的11个质量指标和8个方法相近度测量,用于引信7个HR和10个RR提取器。 在测试前,在单独的五个主体中选择过滤器、指标方向、加权参数和学习到的山脊基线。 融合被比作等同平均,一个恒定的典型率预测器,是事先和事后选择的最好的单一方法,以及一个以平分法为基础的平分虚空的每道窗道,使用主题级的靴子置信间隔. 就人力资源而言,质量加权聚变将平均绝对误差减少10.9%[5.2,18.4],相对于事先选择的方法减少15.6%[8.1,23.1],在统计学上与事后选择的最佳方法无法区分。 双方同意的加权方法没有改善平均数。 就经常资源而言,指标无法确定更准确的估计数:更清晰的质量加权误差增加(-2.6% [4.8,-0.8]),与参考值无关的引信估计数(r. 0.22),平均率低于典型比率预测值(-3.1% [-6.1,-0.4))。 在第二个呼吸道参考中,经常资源的明显增加反映了向典型比率发展的估计。 对视频HR来说,质量导向聚变是值得的;对RR来说,30s的窗口改进了估计,但没有聚变.

articles.title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
articles.content: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). articles.title_zh: 灵活多层多溶液 临床脑磁共振超解 使用异相定向变相编码:尼日利亚Cohort的专家阅读器评价
articles.content_zh: 高分辨率脑磁共振对神经辐射评估很重要,然而常规的临床协议往往依赖于快速,异同位素2D的获取,特别是在资源受限的环境下. 这些获取在取向,对齐和解剖覆盖方面可能有所不同,导致图像堆叠部分重叠. 现有的以学习为基础的超解析方法一般依赖于单一的,限制不足的输入或具有理想化的获取几何的固定多层结构. 我们引入了MS-HVED,一个灵活多层脑磁共振超分辨率的序列不可知框架. 可用的轴线,冠线和地平线堆栈被独立地编码成多尺度高斯后架并被熔化,使用视野-知觉产品-高斯人配方来限制来自无支持区域的贡献. 物理知情域随机化模拟了不同的临床获取条件,包括偏斜性,部分覆盖和成像工艺. MS-HVED在合成基准中实现了竞争性或高水平的再生忠心度,并相对于低分辨率输入物改善了下游组织分化. 为了评估培训组群之外的一般情况,我们对尼日利亚一个组群的30个常规脑核磁共振检查进行了外部临床鉴定,这些组群在医疗成像研究中代表人数不足。 这些检查构成了失明阅读器研究的最大组成部分,涉及44个真实病例和7个神经辐射专家. 在尼日利亚,在210项对等评估中的187项评估中,MS-HVED优于整体图像质量监督基线。 在所有临床组群中,MS-HVED在所有可用投入(5.93对4.49,p <.001)的基础上取得了更高的总质量分数,在省略轴心或冠心投入时,偏好持续存在(p <.001)。 github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved的代码

articles.title: Portrait Fitness as a Pretext: Probing Implicit Demographic Bias in VLMs
articles.content: We audit face-related bias in VLMs using BALPORTRAITS, a new balanced dataset of 9,000 fictional portraits across ethnicity, gender, and age segments. Sixteen VLMs estimate portrait fitness scores for occupations, brands, activities, and banking or insurance products within an advertising-casting framework designed to avoid direct inference of protected attributes. Item-level estimations are aggregated with scenario-specific prestige scores to compare rankings across demographic groups. While the magnitude and direction of these biases vary across scenarios, model families, and demographic dimensions, with age, ethnicity, and gender contributing differently depending on the task, we find demographic dispersion across all evaluated models, with a majority of pairwise segment differences reaching statistical significance. This study introduces a controlled protocol to assess implicit face-related associations and demonstrates that single-scenario or single-attribute audits are insufficient.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 外观适合作为前言: 证明隐性人口 VLMs 中的偏见
articles.content_zh: 我们使用BALPORTRATS来审计与VLM相关的面相偏差,这是一套新的平衡数据集,包含9 000幅跨族裔、性别和年龄的虚构肖像。 16个VLMs对职业,品牌,活动以及银行或保险产品在广告广播框架内的肖像健身分数进行估算,以避免直接推断受保护的属性. 项目一级的估计与特定情景的声望分数相加,以比较各人口组的排名。 虽然这些偏见的程度和取向因情景、模范家庭和人口因素而异,年龄、族裔和性别因任务的不同而有不同的贡献,但我们发现,在所有评价模型中,人口分布分散,大多数对等部分的差异具有统计意义。 这项研究引入了评估隐性面相协会的控制协议,并表明单一情景或单一属性审计是不够的。

articles.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
articles.content: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VideoNexus:视频感知 超越理性背景
articles.content_zh: 了解长视频需要查找证据,解决视觉细节,并将观测结果纳入答案。 即使在存在相关证据的情况下,在漫长而密集的视觉序列中进行这些操作也会给感知和推理带来负担. 视频代理可以进行选择性检查,但将帧还给计划员仍然会在其推理背景中积累视觉信息. 授权感知减轻了这一负担,但很少采样可能会错过决定性的细节,而按框架描述可以保持上下文的增长. 我们引入了VideoNexus,这是一个无培训的框架,它将详细的视频感知与由证据驱动的规划和推理区分开来. 计划者控制检查地点, 解决什么, 和如何密集的采样。 感知子代理在独立的情况下处理本地音频视频,并压缩返回,基于时间的证据进行迭代搜索和核实. 使用双子座 3.8 Flash进行规划和感知,VideoNexus在全LV Bench上达到88.6%的精度,分别以3.6分和1.1分超过同背骨静地摄取和内置代理处理,以后者所测API成本的44%. 成对的LV Bench子集的活化显示出较低的计划器输入和更高的精度. 由于Kimi K3是共享的骨干,VideoNexus在我们的评价中比官方的Video-GAIA ReAct利用率提高了8.5分. 这些成果有助于进行紧凑的证据交流,将详细观察与有效的规划和推理结合起来。

articles.title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
articles.content: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 遮罩不是对象:3D高斯分块的体积监督
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板化使得高斯原始人能够进行对象级操作,然而现有的分解方法大多通过渲染出的观点来训练和评价. 这种不匹配可以产生不完全的3D选择的准确制成的口罩,因为α-混合特性监督集中于学习占优势的贡献者,而留下被占有或低贡献的高斯人被弱监督. 我们提出VODA,一个插件和游戏监督目标,利用本地深度结构将每个像素贡献者分组,并直接监督选定的深度集群中的所有高斯人,绕过贡献加权梯度交付. 为了评估体积完整性,我们采用了“清除-3D”这一合成物体清除基准,以及“清除深度误差”(RDE),这是比较预测和地面真实深度变化的尺度。 在四个基于渲染的基线中,自愿官方发展援助不断改进去除-3D的分量,同时保持或改进LERF和ScanNet的性能。 进一步的分析表明,VODA恢复了低贡献高斯人,而简单的梯度再加权和空间传播则无法复制可比较的收益.

articles.title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
articles.content: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 我们的视野: Omni AI- Generated 视频检测的自演代理
articles.content_zh: 录像制作方面最近的进展要求以明确的法医证据为基础进行可靠的探测。 然而,目前的方法主要取决于忽略简短或局部文物的单一思维链推理,或预先界定的多代理工作流程,这些流程在选择相关检查时提供有限的灵活性。 即使进行了适应性调查,单靠优化调查政策并不能直接提高固定专家的法证能力. 我们介绍WeVisForensics,一个代理框架,在这个框架里,一个主要调查员协调一个自演的法医检查员子代理人图书馆,这些代理人跨越视觉和音频提示。 调查员了解需要检查的文物类型、哪个窗口和何时结束,这些互动为两个级别的代理人提供共享反馈。 我们的双时级政策优化战略,即DTPO,通过快速加强调查员的学习和在附加说明的文物间隔的指导下对视察员的更慢的改进,以报告他们曾经丢弃的微妙文物,从而关闭了这一循环。 此外,我们管理ForenCue-30K,将特定作用的法证说明和互动轨迹结合起来,以监督个别检查及其协调,并配有一个辅助学习库。 实验显示,WeVisForensics的平均检测精度为95.2%,跨越域内,域外和代理基准,比最强的先行探测器高9.0%,同时将判断结果建立在局部证据上.

articles.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
articles.content: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 生活:使流媒体模式互动
articles.content_zh: 流取视频LLMS可以持续地观察世界,但往往孤立地处理用户请求. 我们引入了 " 生命之声 " (ALIVE),这是一个互动的流媒体模型,支持主动监测、流媒体任务协调和寻求反馈的互动。 我们建造了ALIVE-SFT-288K和ALIVE-RL-3K进行两阶段训练. 相互矛盾的监管微调教导了何时和如何应对,而与行为协调信贷转让(BACA)的强化学习结合了轨迹层面和地方优势,以完善决策、反应和多回合互动的沉默。 我们还引入了FSI-Bench,以评估寻求反馈和随后完成任务的情况。 在四个公共基准和FSI-Bench的比较模型中,ALIVE总体得分最高,显示出强大的流派理解和互动能力.

articles.title: Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data
articles.content: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble disagreement.These findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探索预测不确定性与利用合成数据进行深层学习模型的模拟与实际差距之间的联系
articles.content_zh: 如今,最先进的质量控制方法(QC)是基于"机器视野",将深度学习(DL)模式与相机检查相结合. 然而,这类解决方案在工业应用中的整合往往由于数据充斥和对模型可靠性的信任而受阻。 虽然合成数据为生成附有完美说明的必要数据提供了一个很有希望的方法,但由于可能出现模拟与实际差距,它带来了与性能退化有关的风险。 本研究利用综艺法进行实验,以估计接受合成数据培训的DL模型的预测不确定性. 结果显示,预测性不确定性在sim-to-real域转移下会增加. 然而,所观测到的性能下降主要是系统性的正反相向偏差,而不是共同的分歧. 这些调查结果有助于在工业环境中有效利用合成数据,同时强调风险评估对于为质量控制任务部署DL解决方案的重要性。

articles.title: Symmetry Detection with Patch Embedding Models by Means of a Scalar Product Transform
articles.content: We present a transformation of vector embeddings representing image patches into scores for point reflection symmetry at the crossing points of patches. The transformation is heavily inspired by the Gradient Product Transform, but it uses the vector embeddings instead of the grayscale gradients. We therefore call it the "Scalar Product Transform" (SPT). Unlike deep learning models for symmetry detection, the method does not require a specific training step tailored for symmetry detection, but it works with arbitrary pre-trained patch embedding models. We have tested the method with DINOv3 and Franca. In our tests, the method outperformed the Gradient Product Transform and was even better than EquiSym, a convolutional neural network specifically designed and trained for symmetry detection. Although the runtime of the SPT is greater than that of EquiSym, the SPT has the advantage that it directly yields a bounding box for the symmetric region.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过 Scalar 产品变换手段对称地检测补丁嵌入模型
articles.content_zh: 我们提出将代表图像补丁的向量嵌入转换成分数,以便在补丁的交叉点进行点反射对称。 转变被"渐变产品变形"所大力启发,但它使用向量嵌入来代替了灰度梯度. 因此,我们称之为"斯卡拉产品变形"(SPT). 与对称检测的深层学习模型不同,该方法并不需要针对对称检测量身定制的特定训练步骤,而是与任意的预训补丁嵌入模型相配合. 我们和DINov3和Franca一起测试过这个方法. 在我们的测试中,这个方法的性能超过了"渐变出产",甚至比"EquiSym"还要好,它是一个为对称检测而专门设计和训练的进化神经网络. 虽然小组委员会的运行时间大于EquiSym,但小组委员会的优点是它直接为对称区域产生一个约束框.

articles.title: Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion for Decomposable Generative Models
articles.content: Generative model pre-training typically optimizes a model as a whole without explicitly organizing its parameters for selective reuse. Decomposable pre-training instead learns reusable components for downstream adaptation while retaining strong generative performance. However, existing knowledge diversion methods incur substantial parameter overhead through weight factorization and rely on fixed component assignments to induce specialization, potentially compromising in-distribution generation quality. We therefore propose Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion (SGKDiv), which learns how generative knowledge is shared and specialized for effective generation and selective downstream reuse. SGKDiv constructs Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels, preserving native computational structure without SVD-based reparameterization. Calibrated condition-wise routing combines a shared usage prior with conditional adjustments, while complementary regularization shapes their allocation, diversity, and magnitude. Together, these designs replace predefined component assignments with adaptively learned and explicitly regulated knowledge specialization. Experiments across diverse model and training settings demonstrate better in-distribution generation than dense and MoE baselines, alongside stronger downstream adaptation than representative PEFT methods across eight datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可分解基因模型的具体性 - 指导性知识转移
articles.content_zh: 基因模型预训一般会在没有明确组织其参数进行选择性再利用的情况下,将模型整体优化. 可分解的预培训则学习下游适应的可再利用组件,同时保留强的遗传性能. 然而,现有知识转移方法通过权重因素化产生大量参数间接费用,并依赖固定组成部分的任务来诱发专业化,这有可能损害分配生成的质量。 因此,我们提议采用特定性指导知识转移(SGKDiv),以学习如何分享基因知识,并专门用于有效生成和选择性下游再利用。 SGKDiv 构造 知识单位从对接的饲料向前通道,在不以SVD为基础的再参数化的情况下,保留本土计算结构. 校准条件的路由在条件调整之前结合了共享的用法,而互补的规范化则塑造了它们的分配,多样性和规模. 这些设计共同取代了预先确定的组件任务,以适应性地学习并明确规范知识专业化. 不同模式和培训环境的实验表明,分布式生成比密集度基线和教育部基线要好,而下游的适应性比8个数据集中有代表性的PEFT方法强。

articles.title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
articles.content: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 电影滚出长相视频的系统框架
articles.content_zh: 视频的流出必须维持超出培训范围的质量,同时处理自我生成的历史和不断增加的缓存费用。 为了应对这些挑战,我们介绍了Movie Roll, 一个连接流线微调、长卷出蒸馏和长视野推论的从基础到稀释的框架。 我们首先通过Windows-Windows Teacher Forcing(WinTF)建立一个强大的多步骤基础,它共同在渐进噪声水平上分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解的分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解的分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解的分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解的分解出分解出分解出分解出分解出分解的分解的分解出分解出分解的分解的分解出分解的分解出分解的分解的分解的分解出分解的分解的分解的分解 为了有效地保留历史背景,分级的KV-cache压缩(HieraKV)利用了分层的注意模式,将完整的历史保留在浅层中,而沉积-最近的历史保留在更深层中. 这在提高生成质量的同时将缓存内存减少78%. 在这个基础上,与分布相匹配蒸馏(CulT-DMD)的累积长调和在每次长自滚过程中都具有固定的参数,在更新前平均局部梯度. 因此,每次更新都将跨时间位置的监督结合起来,同时只保留一个当地计算图,以便能够对几个步骤的生成器进行有效的长期推出培训。 为了将生成扩展到训练地平线以外,KV重算对两种模型的上下文有限制,而导取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 作为这些建模进步的补充,FBCA关注和PS-VAE解码支持高效的培训和流出输出. 在"Helios Bench"上,"Movie Roll-Base"在接受最多为15分的视频培训后仍保持30分的竞争力,"Movie Roll-Distilled"在单项和多项活动评价的比较方法中总分最高,最高可达60分,将持续自然与活性运动相结合.

articles.title: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
articles.content: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: A2A-UAV:用于无人机探测和识别的多式空对空数据集
articles.content_zh: 低空空空域无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)的快速发展增加了未经授权入侵的风险,使得对不合作的无人驾驶飞行器的可靠探测和识别对低空空域安全至关重要. 然而,现有的公共无人驾驶飞行器数据集大多是从固定的地基角度获取的,仅限于成像或射频(RF)观测,这限制了感知覆盖范围和部署的灵活性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了A2A-UAV,这是一个用于无人驾驶航空器探测和识别的多式空对空数据集。 具体地说,在日间和夜间条件下,在三个户外地点记录了15个目标无人驾驶飞行器,这些无人驾驶飞行器搭载平台配备了RGB-热振相机、全景相机、RF频谱分析仪和毫米波雷达。 该数据集包含105,294个时间相通的RGB,全景,热能,和RF时间频率图像和雷达点云等样本. 此外,所有209,539个主要小型无人驾驶飞行器目标的捆绑箱都经过人工说明和交叉核对。 因此,A2A-UAV为低空空空域的空对空无人驾驶飞行器探测、识别和多模式聚变提供了宝贵的资源。

articles.title: Rotation-Invariant Machine Learning for Highly Symmetric Molecular Configurations
articles.content: Atomistic machine learning can approximate expensive quantum mechanical calculations at a fraction of their computational cost, but accuracy depends strongly on how the three-dimensional atomic environments are represented. Invariant representations enable fast computation but can fail to distinguish geometrically distinct configurations, especially in highly symmetric environments. We introduce a lightweight benchmark to evaluate expressivity on $n$-fold symmetric configurations, and use it to expose degeneracies in both invariant and equivariant architectures. Guided by these results, we construct a new invariant basis for HIP-HOP which resolves most of the identified failures. On a methane simulation dataset, the extended basis achieves the lowest error among the HIP-HOP variants and has similar accuracy to EquiformerV3 while running $3.2\times$ faster at inference. These results show that carefully constructed invariant representations can mitigate key expressivity limitations while balancing accuracy and computational efficiency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高度对称分子配置的旋转- 惯性机器学习
articles.content_zh: 原子主义的机器学习可以以它们计算成本的一分之一来估计昂贵的量子机械计算,但准确性在很大程度上取决于三维原子环境是如何表现的. 变化无常的表示式可以使快速计算成为可能,但无法区分几何特征的配置,特别是在高度对称的环境中. 我们采用了一个轻量级基准来评价美元倍对称配置的表达性,并用它来揭露各种结构的变异性和等同性。 以这些结果为指导,我们为HIP-HOP构建了一个新的无变无常的基础,解决了大多数已查明的失败. 在甲烷模拟数据集上,扩展基础实现了HIP-HOP变体中最小的出错,并且与EquiformerV3具有相近的精度,同时在推论中运行了3.2\times$. 这些结果显示,精心构建的无差异表示可以减轻关键表达性限制,同时平衡准确性和计算效率.

articles.title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
articles.content: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Fix, Don't Recept:物理-模拟训练,以校正患者在牙科全景辐射图中的定位错误
articles.content_zh: 患者定位出错会扭曲全景放射图,导致重复检查. 这项研究调查人工智能,以纠正现有图像中的这些错误. 一个基于物理的模拟器从圆锥束计算成的成像量中生成对位和错位的全景,并带有可控的单个和组合定位错误. 比较了五种方法:U-Net、pix2pix、有条件的传播、一个有错误条件的模型、一个有具体错误的专家的混合物。 评价采用三套测试的图像相似度和几何测量标准。 所有方法都改进了图像的相似性并减少了几何误差,U-Net和两个出错意识方法都比pix2pix和有条件的传播效果好.

articles.title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
articles.content: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Déjà-Events:多视图 三维几何与事件相机通过 Sparsity-Aware 适应Gating
articles.content_zh: 事件相机在常规相机模糊或饱和的地方不断捕捉到结构,这使其在快速或亮度低的场景中吸引到3D感知. 然而,具有密集的3D地面真伪的事件数据集远比向上3D重建模型背后的图像集要小而多样. 我们向大家介绍Déjà-Events, 一种仅以事件为主的模型, 它从多个角度预测深度、相机姿势和指向。 我们不依赖稀缺的3D标签,而是从Déjà View中提取出,Déjà View是一种向导的RGB模型,它通过反复应用一个共享变压器块来完善它的代号. 在对齐的RGB和事件录音上,事件学生学会了复制被冷冻的老师最后的道具,这不需要深度或提出地上真言,训练的参数只有1%左右. 由于事件在边缘和移动的纹理上是密集的,但在无纹理的区域却几乎不存在,我们进一步引入了sparsity-aware可适应的地标,使共享块的地门适应于事件,并按事件密度调整每个地段,这样精确度就随着完善步骤的加入而保持. Déjà-Events只接受模拟数据训练,在我们评价的基于事件的方法中实现了最低点映射误差,在EventScape上实现了零拍取真实的MVSEC和DSEC数据集. 在DSEC上,它用大约十分之一的参数将最强基线(0.15对0.30 AbsRel)的误差减半. 它也拥有EventScape和DSEC上的最低深度误差和EventScape上的最低轨迹误差.

articles.title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Anachro Bench:评估大视野-语言模型中的历史一致性
articles.content_zh: 现有大视野语言 示范基准主要评价一般日常情况下的视觉理解,使历史与特定时代保持一致,国家在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出Anachro Bench,这是评价视觉场景历史一致性的可控歧视基准。 它包含了由从19世纪后期到20世纪初的8个国家出产的1600个图像对相,每个图像将一个原始的历史图像与一个不合时代的版本相配,包含一个无缝插入的现代物体. Anachro Bench评价了三个方面: 插入对象感知,测试模型是否检测被插入的现代对象; 时代-国家一致性,评估场景是否符合指定的时代和国家; 有条件的时代-国家一致性,仅在被插入对象被正确感知时测量一致性判断. 当一个模型认为现代物体但仍然判断该场景具有历史一致性时,就会产生错误的一致性判断。 总之,Anachro Bench揭示了插入对象感知与时代国家一致性判断之间的差距,为这种行为提供了有针对性的评价.

articles.title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
articles.content: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FM-Recon:探索加速心血管核磁共振模型 重建
articles.content_zh: 基础模型在各种医疗成像任务中显示出很强的地物提取能力,但其核磁共振重建的潜力基本上仍未得到探讨,特别是在未卷入的重建网络和文物腐蚀的投入中。 在这项工作中,我们探讨预先训练的基础模型的特征是否以及如何有利于加速心脏焚烧核磁共振的重建。 为此,我们提议FM-Recon,这个框架将从被冻结的图像编码器中提取的地物从地基模型中精炼并整合入一个未滚动的重建网络. 通过对CMRxRecon2023数据集的广泛实验,我们系统地评价不同重建环境的基础模型特征。 我们的结果表明,基础模型能够从文物损坏的投入中提取信息说明,并改进重建业绩,特别是在适度加速因素方面。 这些调查结果显示了加快核磁共振重建的基础模型特征的潜力,并使人们深入了解这些特征如何有效地融入未滚动的重建网络。

articles.title: PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks
articles.content: Many materials and tissues, including carbon-nanotube sheets, collagen and paper, comprise overlapping strands whose arrangement influences their effective properties. Measuring this geometry from micrographs requires individual strands to be traced through crossings and signal gaps, which merge distinct strands or split one strand into disconnected fragments. We present PLECTA (from Latin plecta, a braid), a deterministic method that segments individual strands using only a binary image whose foreground pixels mark strand centrelines. At each junction, PLECTA selects which strand segments continue into one another while allowing segments to terminate. It formulates this decision as an exact maximum-weight partial-matching problem, with an explicit penalty for unpaired segments and no restriction on the number of segments entering a junction. The output permits crossing pixels to belong to multiple strands. On synthetic scenes, PLECTA resolved strand identities more accurately than three released alternatives at every density tested. The same ranking held on an independently published generator run at its own settings. A separate stage uses the corresponding greyscale micrograph to estimate which strand lies on top at each crossing. The complete workflow is demonstrated on scanning electron micrographs of carbon nanotube sheets, from raw images to individual strand instances with estimated crossing order, without manual annotations for training or as pipeline inputs.

articles.content_zh: 许多材料和组织,包括碳-Nanoube活板、焦炭和纸张,由重叠的线条组成,其安排影响其有效特性。 从微图中测量出这种几何特征,需要通过交叉和信号缺口来追踪个别线段,这些线段将不同的线段合并,或将一线分割成断开的片段。 我们提出 PLECTA(取自拉丁文 plecta, 一条辫子),一种决定性的方法,它只使用一个二进制图像,其前方像素标记了线条中线。 在每一个交叉口,PLECTA会选择哪些线段会相继相接,同时允许线段终止. 它将这一决定表述为精确的最大重量部分配对问题,明确了对未配对部分的处罚,对进入交叉口部分的数量没有限制。 输出允许跨像素属于多端. 在合成场景中,PLECTA在每一次密度测试中比三个释放的替代品更准确地解析了线条特征. 在独立出版的生成器运行时在自己的设置上保持同样的排名. 一个单独的阶段使用相应的灰度缩微图来估计每个交叉口上方的线程。 完整的工作流程在扫描碳纳米管平面的电子微图、从原始图像到有估计过境顺序的单个链条实例、没有培训的人工说明或管道投入上展示。

articles.title: QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.

articles.title: A Study on Performance Enhancement of a Webcam-Based Real-Time Eye-Tracking System
articles.content: This study proposes a real-time gaze-tracking system that uses a standard RGB webcam to estimate screen coordinates. The system combines ETH-XGaze-based gaze estimation with nine-point calibration and polynomial ridge regression. To reduce errors caused by changes in head position, it also applies a conditional residual correction derived from head and pose features extracted with RTMPose. Whether this correction is used depends on the reliability of the detected features and the characteristics of the calibration data. In a preliminary experiment, one participant completed trials at 12 screen targets. The resulting mean screen-coordinate error was 204.24 pixels, which was 35.83% lower than that of xgaze-js and 57.69% lower than that of gaze_tracker. The system produced valid gaze estimates for all 12 targets. These preliminary findings demonstrate the feasibility of combining user-specific calibration with conditional pose-based correction for webcam gaze tracking. Because the evaluation involved only one participant, further experiments with more participants and a wider range of postures are required.
