articles.title_zh: 关于改进基于网络的实时观察跟踪系统的性能研究
articles.content_zh: 本研究提出实时的目视跟踪系统,使用标准的RGB网络相机来估计屏幕坐标. 该系统将基于ETH-XGaze的视差估计与九分校正和多诺米脊回归相结合. 为了减少由头部位置变化所引发的错误,它也采用了从头部取出并用RTMPose提取出外形特征的有条件剩余校正. 这种校正是否被使用取决于被检测到的特征的可靠性和校正数据的特点. 在初步试验中,一名参与者完成了12个屏幕目标的试验。 由此产生的平均屏幕坐标误差为204.24像素,比xgaze-js低35.83%,比Look_tracker低57.69%. 该系统为所有12个目标提供了有效的目光估计。 这些初步调查结果表明,将针对用户的校正与有条件的姿势校正相结合,用于网络摄像头视线跟踪是可行的。 由于评价只涉及一名参与者,因此需要进一步进行试验,让更多的参与者参与,并采取更广泛的姿态。

articles.title: Investigating the Benefit of Transfer Learning from the Locus Coeruleus for Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta Segmentation
articles.content: The substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc) is a small midbrain nucleus that degenerates early in Parkinson's disease (PD). T1-weighted FLASH MRI enables its visualization and may support early detection of neurodegeneration. However, manual segmentation is difficult and time-consuming, and deep learning models often suffer from the limited availability of labeled data. Transfer learning (TL) may help by adapting pre-trained models to small datasets. We investigate whether TL from a model trained on the locus coeruleus (LC), a nucleus with a similar appearance in this sequence, improves SNpc segmentation. Several TL strategies were evaluated using a 3D U-Net. With as few as 5-14 labeled subjects, TL and training from scratch achieved similar performance, reaching a Dice similarity coefficient of up to 0.77, close to reported inter-rater agreement. No TL strategy differed significantly from training from scratch, suggesting that initialization from the LC offers no significant benefit for SNpc segmentation.

articles.title: Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection
articles.content: Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c_x,c_y,w,h,θ)$ and $(c_x,c_y,h,w,θ+π/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alone. Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising starts denoising earlier, ramps its loss weight linearly, and weights each query by the teacher score and encoding margin. All three are parameter-free and require no additional forward pass. Across all label ratios of DOTA-v2.0, Oriented Semi-DETR outperforms DETR-based supervised and semi-supervised baselines, with the largest gains at the strict IoU threshold.

articles.content_zh: 半被监督的对象检测最近被扩展至DETR,其中向外的框引入了轴相匹配的框不会出现的模糊:从参数到矩形的映射为2对一,因为$(c_x,c_y,w,h,-)$和$(c_x,c_y,h,w,-)$(θ+π)表示相同的旋转矩形. 损失和匹配费用是从参数计算出来的,因此,在驱动培训的衡量尺度中,两个在空间中重合的方框可能相去甚远。 一个正确本地化的学生盒随后被回归损失所惩罚,膨胀的匹配成本导致高斯混合模型(GMM)过滤器丢弃. 我们提议Oriented Semi-DETR,只要一个假盒子进入训练阶段,就消除了这种模糊. 交换相接的目标选择向更接近学生预测的编码倒退. 互换变量可靠性 成本在匹配成本内的两个编码上最小化,因此过滤器独自决定几何. 交换-认识 Pseudo-label Denoising 开始更早地去名化,将损失的重量线性地拉高,按老师的分数和编码比值对每个查询进行加权. 所有这三项都是无参数的,不需要额外的前行通行证. 在DOTA-v2.0的所有标签比率中,Oriented Semi-DETR比基于DETR的有监督的和半有监督的基线要好,在严格的IoU阈值上收益最大.

articles.title: RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing
articles.content: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications, and is applied on top of FlowEdit-based editors. On PIE-Bench, RAGE achieves the best overall rank among 17 methods and substantially improves background preservation on both Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX backbones while maintaining competitive editing quality.

articles.title_zh: RAGE: 流线图像编辑的剩余辅助工具
articles.content_zh: 最近的无倒置,以流为主的图像编辑方法通过差速场将源图像向目标进化. 我们注意到,这一速度领域没有明确说明应保留哪些区域,导致非编辑区域意外漂移。 为了解决这个问题,我们制定了源忠贞控制方案,作为一个有条理的最佳控制问题,在编辑轨迹上执行编辑剩余部分的选择性忠贞术语。 解决这一问题并近似其解决办法产生 " 残余物分量原则 " :每个潜在成分被拉回源头,其收益随当地残留量成倍地衰减,从而抑制了小偏差,而大型、精密有意义的编辑则不受阻碍地通过。 拟议的方法RAGE每取样步骤只需要一个轻量级的入门插值,不涉及口罩估计,注意力图,再培训,或特定架构的修改,并被应用在FlowEdit编辑器上. 在PIE-Bench上,RAGE在17个方法中取得了最佳的总体排名,并大大改进了稳定传播3和FLUX主干线上的背景保存,同时保持了竞争性编辑质量.

articles.title: Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs
articles.content: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articles.title_zh: Token Stacking 以外: MLLMs 的多尺度可视化调制和可适应的 Fused-fetature 校正
articles.content_zh: 当前多式联运 大语言模型(MLLMs)已经迅速进步并遵循了两大范式:一是将可视化和文字符号相接以输入大语言模型(LLM),而一是将可视化知识注入了LLM的Feed-Forward Network(FFNs). 然而,前者引入了大量冗余的视觉符号,大大增加了计算间接费用. 后者缩短了序列长度,但将图像完全从输入阶段去除,这可能会阻碍图像相关知识的激活. 此外,由于跨模式语义差异,天真地将视觉知识注射到FFN中可以诱发活性分布转变. 为了应对这些挑战,我们开发了Beyond Token Stacking(BTS),这是MLLMs的新视觉增强框架. 具体来说,我们提出一个多尺度可视化模组(MVM)机制,通过调制在输入阶段注入多尺度可视化信息而不会增加符号序列长度. 此外,我们开发了一个适应性纤维-外观校正模块,进行每道外缘校正,将视觉注射从FFN分层的配正中解开,提高多式聚变稳定性,同时保留语言前缀。 实验显示我们的方法实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
articles.content: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN.

articles.title_zh: DRaGAN: 汽车雷达感知多雷达点云编码动态图形注意网络
articles.content_zh: 雷达是天气扰动感知的关键方式。 与相机和LiDAR等光学传感器不同,雷达由于波长较长而能穿透出雾,雨和雪,而近期的硬件进步也稳步地提高了空间分辨率,从而使其与自主系统越来越相关. 虽然处理原始雷达数据需要大量的内存计算,但大多数现有工作都侧重于类似于LiDAR的预处理点-云数据. 然而,稀疏的雷达点和传感器相对的同位素使得以LiDAR为导向的编码器不尽人意. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了DRAGAN,一个动态的多雷达点云的图注网络. DRAGAN引入了传感器相对的Fourier角和射程编码来捕捉固定孔径雷达特性,沿每个传感器的视线有门的短程和长程中枢节点,用于高效的局部-全球信息传递,并用注意力制导动态重接来推倒微弱的边缘并增加限量的潜在连接,仅限于双跳相邻. 这减少了更深层中被加工的边缘数量,同时保持了代表质量. 在卡车上,DRaGAN将试验NDS比评估的雷达GN基线改进了10.10分,并将所报告的FLOP模型数减少了63.7%。 这种取舍包括将模型延迟度从40米提高到53.16米,将可训练参数从1.2M提高到1.7M,用于评价执行情况。 在https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRAGAN上可以查到代码和预先训练过的模型。

articles.title: Model-based neural network for global floodplains analysis
articles.content: We address the super-resolution of multispectral remote sensing imagery for long-term floodplain monitoring, enhancing Landsat acquisitions towards Sentinel-2 resolution. Exploiting the period during which both missions observed the same areas, we build DLhasa-L2S , to our knowledge the first paired dataset dedicated to multispectral super-resolution for river analysis. It covers the Lhasa River (Tibet), whose strong anthropogenic changes and diverse hydromorphological profiles make it an ideal study area. We developed two model-based neural networks: a forward-backward (FB) plug-and-play scheme and an unfolded FB scheme. We compared them against learned neural networks baselines (SwinIR, RDN) on synthetic data, on real scenes, and through a statistical test over the whole real paired Landsat-Sentinel dataset. The unfolded network achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on the real RGB components with fast inference, offering the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. For NDWI-based water segmentation, its performance shows no statistically significant difference from that of the best methods.

articles.title_zh: 全球洪泛分析模型神经网络
articles.content_zh: 我们处理多光谱遥感图像的超分辨率问题,以进行长期的洪平面监测,加强Landsat的获取,以达到Sentinel-2分辨率。 我们探索了两个特派团观测同一地区的时期,建造了DLHASA-L2S,据我们所知,这是专门用于河流分析的多光谱超分辨率的第一个对接数据集。 它覆盖了拉萨河(西藏),其强烈的人为变化和多样的水文形态特征使其成为理想的研究区. 我们开发出两个以模型为基础的神经网络:一个前向后向的(FB)插件和游戏方案以及一个已展开的(FB)方案. 我们在合成数据上,在真实场景上,通过对真实对齐的Landsat-Sentinel数据集进行统计测试, 将它们与所学神经网络基线(SwinIR, RDN)进行比较。 所展开的网络在真实的RGB组件上实现了最高的PSNR和SSIM,快速推导,提供了精度和计算成本之间的最佳取舍. 对于基于NDWI的分水法,其性能显示与最佳方法没有统计上的重大区别.

articles.title: Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences
articles.content: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.

articles.title_zh: 写作一次, 分序: 双向时间一致性, 弱导分序的回声心律分序
articles.content_zh: 暂时的医学影像分解依赖于像素相向的注释,对于长相影像序列来说,这些注释过于昂贵. 现有的由薄弱监督的方法减轻了每个框架的注释负担,但仍需要在整个序列中重复说明。 此外,监督很少会导致暂时不稳定的表述。 应对这两项挑战需要一种模式,能够利用大规模预训产生的强大的空间前兆,同时尽量减少对密集说明的依赖。 冻结的2D愿景基础模型为此提供了一个有希望的基础,提供了具有低可训练参数的可转移空间表示. 然而,它们缺乏明确的时间模型,限制了它们在解剖序列中传播可靠信息的能力。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个由薄弱监督的框架,用于从一个被附加了说明的单一框架进行时间分解,所有剩余框架都未加标签。 该框架结合了中间-教师架构中存在的DINOv3编码器的参数效率改造. 此外,包括时间损失在内的一系列补充损失有助于为无标签的框架产生可靠的分块前兆。 这种配方使注释与序列长度脱钩,同时保留了被预先训练的编码器的可转让空间知识. 对可公开获取的CAMUS和CardiacNet数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比其他有文字监督的方法要好。 这些结果表明,通过极少数的监管,可以实现准确和时间上一致的分解,大大减少了时间回声心分解的注释要求,并为可扩展的临床部署提供了实用框架.

articles.title: Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection
articles.content: Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 区域-VAD:视频异常本地化和通过区域选择检测
articles.content_zh: 异常点是局部事件, 多数方法将整个框架集合成一个单一向量,由向量排列出框架,然后得出一个位置作为分数的显著地图. 全帧集合将异常与其背景相混合,因此一个探测器可以从场景上下文达到有竞争力的基准分数,而不能显示场景中的异常发生地. 我们提出区域-VAD,它首先选择一个区域,然后单独从该区域发现异常。 区域-VAD在被冻结的地基模型的标志上选择一个明显的矩形,并且只从盒子内的标志上评出异常分数,通过注意力集合,然后是标准的时间头. 矩形没有被学习出来,是被冻结的指使在相接的段间变化最多的盒子,在编码器的所有四个特征预测中,它是通过对指使网格的矩形进行详尽搜索而发现的. 只有集合和时间头经过了训练,从没有盒子,口罩或帧级说明的视频级别标签,没有经过训练的组件在所选区域之外读取一个符号. 5个数据集的实验,所有数据集和主干共享一个定位器配置,显示区域-VAD在UCF-Crime和MSAD的竞争性检测性能上实现了最先进的异常定位.

articles.title: How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector
articles.content: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($Δ_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.

articles.title_zh: 如何解释无法解释的视频异常检测器
articles.content_zh: 监督不力 Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) 模型从高维特性分配出异常分数,它们的预测仍然无法解释. 显要地图显示一个模型的外观而非所依赖的,由Vision-Language Models(VLMs)制作的描述由异常分数从未读取的分支生成. 为了弥补这种忠诚差距,我们提议\textbf{解释无法解释的(ETU)},这是一个分类-不可知框架,通过在功能空间的反事实干预来审计冻结的VAD模型。 ETU将视频特性映射到一个离散的依赖图上,其中包含物剂,动作和结果($A_r\r到A_a\to A_o$),以图被遮住的选定节点来再生这些特性,并测量被冷冻的探测器的分数变化;一组干预措施对每一个探测器都适用不变. 生成器只接受过重建输入特性的培训,因此它无法了解它被要求测量的对比度,我们通过实验来验证审计结果的每一个替代解释,从再生成本到大小相匹配的随机删除. 关于从一个CLIP编码器获得的UCF-Crime特性,我们显示,替代场景语义对大多数探测器来说是最大的下降,并且去除图中的结果链($Δ_{rel}$)会改变所有六个被审计的探测器的异常分数远不止于去除同样数目的随机节点,尽管随机删除会干扰同样多的特性. 我们显示,这种有针对性的行为来自于图嵌入的分化目标. 没有它,这两种干预就变得不可区分,而且随着发生器的分数也存在分歧,探测器的分数变化会随着重建的转移而不是被移除的语义而发生.

articles.title: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
articles.content: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: IGREcon4D: 动态- 对象- 智能种子- 前向重建驱动场景
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 4D驱动相机场重建能够高效地模拟动态自动驾驶相机场景,但目前的方法有两种互补的故障模式:交通参与者的语义渗入到高斯地点的静态表现和几何漂移到不同角度. 我们提出\textbf{IGRecon4D},这是一个向导的动态场景重建框架,它通过培训时间实例前蒸馏和LiDAR-anchored Gaussian定位来解决这些故障。 具体地说,一个实例级语义分支提供了潜在的动态参与者先行性,通过实例-动态一致性约束被分解成动态任务学习,鼓励交通参与区高召本地化,容易发生动态-静态渗出. 平行地,稀疏的LiDAR测量指导了密度深度估计,所形成的深度被后期预测为锚地高斯位置,以提高多视图几何一致性. 对Waymo开放数据集的实验和对nuScens的零镜头评价表明,在跨数据集评价下,主要基准的全面图像重建得到了改进,交通参与区重建得到加强。

articles.title: VAE Rhythm: Temporal Decoding Traces for AI-Generated Video Detection
articles.content: Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自愿援助 韵律:用于AI-Geneed视频检测的时空解码追踪
articles.content_zh: 可见文物是探测所生成的视频的不可靠提示,因为较新的发电机学会去除. 相反,我们检测到发电管道本身留下的痕迹。 大部分视频生成器解码潜伏器带有3D因子VAE,能将相接的帧相接地分解出来,因此生成的帧的忠诚度会随其在一组中的位置而定期地上升和下降. 我们称之为定期追踪 VAE韵律。 真实的视频是按帧捕获的,没有. 我们提议进行相位扫描, 扫描用连续起始的现成VAE来重建一个剪辑,抵消并测量这些相抵重建出错的周期。 我们在我们测试的31个发电机的39个变体中,大多数都发现了VAE韵律,包括闭源Sora,克林3.0和种子2.0. 我们用节奏作为零射分数,作为现有探测器的插座,并作为数据引擎,将真实的视频与他们的VAE重建相配,以训练我们的探测器CaDet. 在DF26上,无训练节奏得分超过所有15个再训练基线,作为插座,它将所有19个被测试的探测器改进了6.7%至23.7%的AUROC. CaDet在AIGVDBench,DF26和3个2026闭源模型上实现了最好的AUROC,在AIGVDBench上它的变体经过训练而没有任何生成的视频,仍然超过90%.

articles.title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark
articles.content: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a model trained on a labelled source domain to an unlabelled target domain without access to the source data. Almost the entire SFDA literature assumes mutually exclusive classes, yet many deployed settings are multi-label. This paper formulates SFDA for multi-label classification and establishes the first benchmark for it: five adaptation tasks over six datasets spanning remote sensing, natural, clipart-style and driving imagery, with four single-label SFDA methods extended to provide the first baselines and a published multi-label method run alongside them, over three seeds. The benchmark shows that extending a single-label method is unreliable rather than merely suboptimal: half of the extended baselines fail to improve on the unadapted source model at all, and on two of the five tasks none of them does. The failures are not incidental. Nearest-centroid pseudo-labelling, softmax-based confidence, the diversity term of information maximization and confidence-weighted prototype construction each rely on mutual exclusivity, and each fails differently without it, so replacing the softmax with per-class sigmoids is a valid but insufficient extension. Multi-label Prototype Alignment with Contrastive Teaching (MPACT) is proposed in response, a mean-teacher framework whose objective, prototype construction and alignment term are each reconsidered for overlapping label sets. It attains the best average on every reported metric and is the only method that improves on the unadapted source model on all five tasks. The analysis further introduces a prototype-agreement diagnostic separating feature-space alignment from self-reinforcing agreement with the classifier, and reports a negative result for confidence-based pseudo-label filtering.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多标签图像分类的无源域适应:框架、基线和基准
articles.content_zh: 无源域适应(SFDA)将一个在被贴上标签的源域上训练的模型改用一个没有贴上标签的目标域而不访问源数据. 几乎所有SFDA文献都假定了相互排斥的类,然而许多被部署的设置都是多标签. 本文件为多标签分类制定了SFDA,并为它确定了第一个基准:在涵盖遥感、自然、剪接和驱动图像等6个数据集的基础上完成5个适应任务,扩展了4个单标签SFDA方法,以提供第一个基线,并公布了一个多标签方法。 基准显示,扩大单一标签方法是不可靠的,而不仅仅是次优化的:延长的基线有一半根本没有改进未经调整的源模型,而且五个任务中有两项没有改进。 失败不是偶然的。 近百分位机器人伪标签,软马克斯基于信心,信息最大化的多样性名词和信心加权原型构造各自依赖于相互排他性,没有这种名词,每个都不同地失败了,所以用每类相模取代软马克斯是有效但不充分的扩展. 作为回应,建议采用多标签原型校正与对照教学(MPACT),即一个平均教师框架,其目标、原型构建和校正术语都经过重新审议,以便使用重叠的标签。 它在每一个报告的衡量标准上都达到最佳平均值,是改进所有五项任务的未调整源模型的唯一方法。 分析还引入了原型-协议诊断法,将地物-空间配对与分类器的自强化协议区分开来,并报告了基于信任的伪标签过滤的负面结果.

articles.title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
articles.content: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/CivilBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Civil Bench: 土木工程多式联运信息整合基准展望-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 人工智能(AI),特别是大型语言模型(LLM)和视觉语言模型(VLMs),越来越多地被应用于民用和结构工程,用于灾害评估,结构分析和工程决策支持. 然而,目前的甚高压材料在多大程度上具备可靠的工程判断所需的推理能力仍然不清楚。 在这项工作中,我们引入了Civil Bench,这是在土木工程和与灾害有关的情景中评估自愿地雷影响的综合基准。 Civil Bench涵盖三大任务领域:顺序理性、基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解,包括数字推理、结构损害评估、风险推断、因果分析和修复规划。 基准是通过一个系统化的专门域数据收集、面向工程的说明、专家注释、问题设计和质量核查的管道构建的。 对有代表性的最新VLM的评价揭示出特定领域推理的严重局限性,序列理性成为主要瓶颈,特别是当模型必须从稀少的结构化观测中推断出数字关系时. 进一步的实验表明,数字前科和外部知识可以减轻这些局限性,尽管其有效性取决于模型可靠地解释和使用现有证据的能力. Civil Bench提供了一个面向能力的试验台,用于确定推理局限性并评估实现可靠的AI辅助工程决策的进展情况。 该基准将在https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/Civil Bench上公布。

articles.title: GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze
articles.content: Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generation provides intuitive semantic control, but language is an indirect way to specify where an interaction should occur on an object. Naming the part to grasp requires object-specific words, and naming the approach side requires a reference frame that a prompt lacks. We propose GRAZE (GRAsp from gaZE), which generates hand-object grasp motion from recorded gaze instead of object and part names. Its Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) maps gaze rays to cues on object geometry, and cross-attention conditions a diffusion Transformer on these cues. We also introduce HOT3D-Grasp, a grasp-centered benchmark with object-disjoint folds built on HOT3D recordings. On unseen objects, GRAZE grasps the target part more often than the strongest text-conditioned baseline (49.3% vs. 43.6%), achieves the highest grasp success (66.3% vs. 46.6%), and transfers without fine-tuning to GazeHOI (45.3% vs. 33.8%). Gaze conveys the approach side: when gaze is rotated around the object, the approach turns with it in 59.1% of cases, against 20.5% for a text model retrained with clock words. On the same backbone, a text prompt names parts better, but gaze adds the approach side. Given both, GRAZE keeps the prompt's part accuracy and follows gaze.

articles.title_zh: GRAZE: 人类迷宫中不明物体的无文字引力合成
articles.content_zh: 文本有条件的手-对象交互(HOI)生成提供了直观语义控制,但语言是一种间接的方式来指定一个对象上应当发生交互的地方. 命名要抓取的部分需要针对对象的单词,命名取向方需要一个提示所缺少的参考框架. 我们提出GRAZE(GRASP from gaZE),它从记录的目光而不是物体和部分名称产生手取物运动. 它的几何- Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) 将凝视射线映射到物体几何上的提示, 并且交叉视线条件 扩散变形器在这些提示上。 我们还引入了HOT3D-Grasp,这是以HOT3D录音为基础,以对象分解折叠为抓取性基准. 在看不见的物体上,GRAZE比最强的文本条件基线(49.3%对43.6%)更经常地掌握目标部分,取得最高的把握成功(66.3%对46.6%),没有向GazeHOI进行微调(45.3%对33.8%)。 Gaze传达了取向的一面:在围绕物体旋转时,取向在59.1%的情况下随取向而转出,而文本模型则有20.5%重新用时钟词来调整. 在同一条主干线上,文字提示名称部分更好,但凝视增加了接近的一面. 鉴于这两种情况,GRAZE保持了提示部分的准确性并跟踪视线.

articles.title: Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery
articles.content: Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

articles.title: MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation
articles.content: CT-to-PET synthesis estimates functional PET images from anatomical CT scans for auxiliary analysis, representation pretraining, and missing-modality completion. Brownian Bridge diffusion models can produce multiple PET candidates of different quality under the same CT condition, exposing an intra-condition quality hierarchy. Candidate quality spans complementary spatial, structural, and intensity dimensions, while DPO-only fine-tuning may compromise absolute synthesis fidelity. We propose MedicalDPO which converts this hierarchy into preference supervision automatically constructed from paired CT-PET training data. Multiple candidates are ranked across the three fidelity dimensions, and strict cross-metric verification retains preferred-rejected pairs with consistent quality separation. Relative denoising-error preference optimization is jointly trained with the original Brownian Bridge objective to anchor the pretrained CT-to-PET mapping, while condition-balanced multi-pair rotation distributes preference supervision across CT conditions. Experiments on BBDM and CPDM show improvements across LPIPS, MAE, SSIM, and PSNR. Further analyses demonstrate metric complementarity and clear pair separation, while ablations show that the original training objective prevents the substantial degradation caused by DPO-only fine-tuning.

articles.title_zh: MedicalDPO:CT到PET翻译的多目标直接偏好优化
articles.content_zh: CT到PET合成从解剖学CT扫描中估算出功能性PET图像,用于辅助分析,表示预训,并完成缺失模式. Brownian Bridge扩散模型可以在相同的CT条件下产生多个质量不同的PET候选,暴露出条件内质量等级. 候选质量跨越互补的空间,结构,和强度维度,而只进行DPO的微调可能会损害绝对的合成忠心. 我们建议医疗计生组织将这一等级转换为优先监管,由配对的CT-PET培训数据自动构建。 多个考生在三个忠诚维度上排名,严格的跨度校正保留了偏好-拒绝的配对,并保持了一致的质量分离. 相对去Noising-error偏好优化与最初的 Brownian Bridge 目标共同培训,以锁定预先训练的CT到PET映射,而条件平衡多派旋转则在CT条件中分配偏好监督. 关于BBDM和CPDM的实验表明,整个LPIPS、MAE、SSIM和PSNR都有所改进。 进一步的分析表明,衡量的互补性和明确的对相分离,而模拟则表明,最初的培训目标防止了仅由DPO微调造成的严重退化。

articles.title: State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
articles.content: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.

articles.title_zh: 跨域最小分片的状态-中度相互作用适应器
articles.content_zh: 跨域多发分片会从几个像素附加说明的辅助口罩中将自然图像预导编码器适应医学或工业领域. 在被冻结的DINOv3范围内,中间式的每头注意信息已经带有目标背景的区别,而基准最终层的相似性和预测并不连贯地反映出来. 我们建议国家-Message互动适应器(SMIA)学习如何更新每条收到的信号,同时保持预先训练的注意力和FFN参数被冻结。 SMIA将每个头部的集合输出(消息)在每一个补丁的预留功能(状态)上进行变换作为条件,允许类似的上下文消息根据接收位置的不同产生有区别的或对立的更新. 由于稀缺的支持口罩只覆盖有限的状态信息组合,共享的低等双线地图将所学到的相互作用限制在低维状态,消息和输出子空间. 在每个被调整的块被冷冻的FFN之前被添加,这些更新生成了被冷冻的FFN和更深的块所精炼的被修改的特性,用于线性读取. SMIA只有0.51M可训练参数和单行道,无支持推论,在20个医疗和工业任务中,SMIA在6个数据集中实现了平均mIoUs的77.40%,在10个镜头中实现了80.99%,以+3.61和+3.93个百分点超过了以往最强的方法. 在对相同的DINOv3主干线的三个基准进行控制下10发的比较中,SMIA还以更好的精确召回平衡,超越了参数匹配的AdaptFormer,LORA和ParaX.

articles.title: MORE: Merge Once, Route Early for Training-Free Multi-Subject Composition from Large LoRA Pools
articles.content: Public hubs offer many personalized LoRAs per text-to-image backbone, yet composing two of them in one image remains fragile. In FLUX, keeping a pool of $K=10$ or $20$ subject LoRAs loaded makes their deltas interfere, and even loading only the two requested LoRAs keeps both subjects in fewer than 4% of images: one subject vanishes, the two fuse, or the image splits into a collage. We present MORE (Merge Once, Route Early), a training-free two-stage pipeline for FLUX. Merge once: the whole pool is folded into a single fixed-rank adapter by the subspace-regression router of SSR-Merge, made reliable by ridge, rank and calibration choices, and factored exactly into a shared part and per-subject parts. Route early: during the first 30% of the denoising steps each subject's part is gated to its layout region; a decaying soft attention bias ties every region to its own subject tokens, and a cyclic swap guidance extrapolates away from the prediction with the subjects' regions permuted, which counteracts region homogenization. On held-out seeds, MORE keeps both subjects in 94.2% ($K=10$) and 78.3% ($K=20$) of images, against 50.8% / 35.8% for FreeFuse and 25.0% / 24.2% for LoRAShop, and reaches an ImageReward of 1.32 (best baseline 0.07), while all $K$ subjects stay in one adapter. With layouts inferred automatically it still keeps both subjects in 70.0% / 55.0% of images.

articles.title_zh: 更多: 合并一次, 从大型 LORA 池中添加培训对象的早期路径
articles.content_zh: 公共枢纽提供许多个性化的LORAs,每个文本到图像主干线,然而将其中两个组成一个图像仍然脆弱. 在FLUX中,保留一个$K=10美元或$20的主体LORAs加载使得他们的三角洲干扰,即使加载只有两个被请求的LORAs将两个主体保存在不到4%的图像中:一个主体消失,两个导火线,或者图像被分解为拼接. 我们提出更多(Morge Once, Route Early),这是FLUX的无培训两阶段管道. 合并一次:整个池由SSR-Merge的子空间后退路由器折叠成一个单一的固定等级的适配器,由脊,分级和校正选择而变得可靠,并精确地计入一个共享部分和每个主体部分. 路由早期:在前30%的去Noiding步骤中,每个主体的部分被门接通到其布局区域;衰弱的软注意力偏好将每个区域与自己的主题符号联系起来,循环互换指导从与被主体所在区域的预测中推导出,这与区域同质化相悖. 在被搁置的种子上,更多的标本在94.2%(K=10美元)和78.3%(K=20美元)的图像中保留,而FreeFuse为50.8%/35.8%,LORASHP为25.0%/24.2%,并达到1.32(最佳基准0.07)的图像奖励,而所有美元标本都留在一个适配器中。 随着布局的自动推断,它仍然将两个主体保留在70.0%/55.0%的图像中.

articles.title: What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds
articles.content: Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 34 games, \textsc{LightAct} improves overall progress by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, respectively, with our strongest model competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Ablations show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance and consistent gains across three policy optimizers. Case studies show how rollouts distinguish actions with identical immediate gains.

articles.title_zh: 是什么让一个好动作? 从视觉世界的经验中学习行动
articles.content_zh: 学习视觉政策需要将互动经验转化为个人决策的指导。 轨迹结果模糊了行动质量,而无指导的探索可以重新审视熟悉的情况。 我们提出\textsc{Light Act},这是一个经验学习框架,将技术指导探索与政策内化联系起来。 互动部分被归纳为经验条目,并被整合为一种针对游戏的技能,指导根集向更广泛的国家覆盖. 在每个方面,通过根据共同冻结政策短时间推出来比较候选人的行动。 环境报告得分收益在续作中平均,并正常化为相对行动奖励,从而产生可重复使用的强化学习监督。 政策培训使用一套紧凑的数据集,其中只有1 024个决策根源在单一源游戏中收集,并与其动作奖励相配. 超过170个GameWorld的任务涵盖34个游戏,\textsc{LightAct}将总体进度分别提高23.6,29.2和13.0个百分点的2B,4B,9B等尺度,我们最强的模型与所报告的专有模型结果竞争. 三个政策优化者在技能指导和持续收益方面表现出更广泛的根态覆盖。 案例研究显示,推出行动如何区分具有相同直接收益的行动。

articles.title: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
articles.content: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

articles.title_zh: MetricHand: 在Metric世界空间进行4D手重建的几何-智能流相匹配
articles.content_zh: 以Egocentral手动提供物理运动监督,以进行可调和的操纵和视觉语言动作预训. 可靠地使用这种监督要求准确和在时间上一致的四维手在平坦的世界空间重建。 现有方法一般是抬高从弱视角到世界坐标的帧估计。 这种近似夫妇在翻译、取向和表达方面的误差, 在世界升起后, 我们介绍MetricHand,一个几何-认识流匹配框架,用于在公尺世界空间进行4D手重建. MetricHand将从手对象相互作用区域到联合关联的表示法的深度前作编码,以保持局部空间结构和度量尺度. 这种几何学方法以视觉特征为迷惑,指导了粗糙的度量估计和时间生成的每一步条件。 该模型共同恢复了世界-空间翻译、全球取向、MANO表达和形状,而结构前科和时间背景则支持部分隔离下的估算。 MetricHand将相机空间MPJPE分别减少49.3%和52.9%,绝对世界空间MPJPE分别减少28.7%和21.7%,与HaWOR相比,手腕本地化误差分别减少48.5%和37.9%. 世界空间加速误差减少了44.2%和64.3%,表明在更精确的绝对本地化的同时,时间忠贞性有所提高。

articles.title: Latent Lattice Language Models
articles.content: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

articles.title_zh: Lattice 语言模型
articles.content_zh: 语言模型通常通过更深或回转的地层和潜在的推理步骤来增加每个地层的计算,而更丰富的剩余连接则改善地层间的信息流. 相反,我们增加计算能力:活动计算的数目表明维持一个模型。 我们介绍Lattice of Latents, 一组每层水平潜流, 随时间而来, 与垂直残余流相伴而来, 纵贯深度。 和超接通,mHC,以及注意力或价值残存一样,拉蒂斯能增强残流,而不会通过深度来增加或改变残流的路径,它提供了相伴的计算状态来坚持跨符. 与混合变形器-SSM架构不同的是,其常年状态主要作为序列相混合的内部内存,这些潜伏物直接会给垂直流的注意力附加条件,KV-cache写作,MLP计算,并解码. 在"变形金刚"(Transformers)上训练了20B FineWeb-Edu令牌,一个406M参数的Lattice模型比一个参数相配的变形金刚将验证棱度从15.41降至14.40. 这些收益跨越建筑变体。 Lattice型由先前的残余相流增强而来:有超接通和输入相余,其验证棱度从15.41(基变形器)和14.22(具有相同增强的变形器)降至13.61. 在Gated DeltaNet,Mamba-2,Triadic GDN,和GDN-Mamba-2等混合体上,它提高了每个被测试的本土州规模的复杂度,Lattice-GDN和Lattice-Triadic-GDN等变体在4个较大本土州的纯基线上表现优于纯度. 这些结果将持久的每层状态确定为衡量语言模型计算的补充轴.

articles.title: Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction
articles.content: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters' discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.

articles.title_zh: 量化人类预报员讨论对热带气旋强度预测的附加值
articles.content_zh: 国家飓风中心定期发布"热带气旋讨论",为了解其"热带气旋预报"提供见解. 本研究报告审查了这些讨论对超出一组数字预测器的强度预测的附加价值。 对于从2002-2023年飓风季开始的637个大西洋和北太平洋东部热带气旋,我们分析讨论文本及其与来自SHIPS和ERA5 10米风场的13个飓风环境预测器的组合,用于在24到120小时的准备时间使用三种建模方法预测强度变化. 一种做法是,案文的端到端深度学习框架表明,仅讨论本身就可以对船舶和港口服务处的24小时强度预测提供可比价值。 在由5个这样的模型组成的组合中,将讨论信息添加到SHIPS预测器中,将2022-2023年气旋24小时最大持续风速预报的平均绝对误差从9.89克降至8.90克特,在整场风暴被再现时,置信间隔排除为零. ERA5风场对风能预测中的平均绝对误差影响不大,模型排名因预测变量,周期和模型类型而异. 我们为这些预测提供预测间隔,在快速强化期间,这些预测的覆盖范围低于90%的目标。 对文本的分析表明,与强度和强度变化有关的词语(如加强度,弱化,眼墙和类别)对于模型预测很重要. 这一回顾性研究显示了预测者讨论的附加价值,并表明多模式学习有助于理解专家人类判断的预测性贡献. 重新分析数据不同于实时分析,讨论至少在其他投入有效时间后3小时后发布,因此这些结果不应在操作上解释.

articles.title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
articles.content: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

articles.title_zh: VLMs计划如何 什么是下一个
articles.content_zh: 当一个视觉语言模型描述一个图像时,它一次命名一个物体,很少重复自己,然而模型是如何规划这个顺序的远不明显. 我们描述一个甚高频用于在它看起来之前决定向何处看的机制。 该机制有四个主要部分。 首先,绑定头会将相关的文本符号与图像相匹配,并将其解为指向匹配图像区域的指针. 第二,相同的绑定头将每个书面答复绑在它来自的区域,模型将它变成进步信号:光标,列表被写入的图像中的位置. 第三,选定步骤选择光标后最近的未写区域,或停止。 最后,凝视头执行所选择的指针并返回一个在那里所绘制的概念,哪个语言头和后期的MLP会变成问题语言中的一个单词. 我们在合成视觉检索任务上通过Qune3-VL模型中的因果补丁验证这个机制的每个部分,并对照其他假设来测试我们的机制. 我们进一步显示,这一机制具有各种输入格式、自然照片和语言,其约束、中继和凝视头出现在2B至32B的每个模型大小上。 这部作品使我们能够调查一个VLM如何将一个问题和图像变成一个答案的序列,逐层地层地层地层地层地物地物地物地物地. 更广泛地说,它为研究模型如何规划长期推出的复杂多步骤任务开辟了道路。 我们的项目可查阅https://plan.baulab.info/。

articles.title: Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering
articles.content:
Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026.
  We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies.
  Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.

articles.title_zh: 任务标题之外: 与 Sparse 自动编码器和语义类群集解译早期护理者任务广告
articles.content_zh:
单是职称和职务说明,对技术作用在不断变化的就业市场中有何不同提供了有限的见解。 为了评估这些角色在工作和行业应用上有何不同,我们根据深层学习和变压器表现设计并比较两种方法,使用2025年12月至2026年10月期间从美国LinkedIn收集的36 081个早期职业岗位。
我们首先采用PERC,简称为预处理(P),嵌入(E),维度降低(R)和集群(C). 我们利用GPT-6 Luna将职务说明段落归类为团队背景、角色任务和资格。 然后我们创建这些章节的组合,并检查嵌入和集群分解段落是否产生关于不同工作角色的有意义的语义集群. 我们使用"最大平均差分"(MMD)来对嵌入分布之间的已观测到的差异进行分级,并使用被预先训练的稀有自编码器(SAE)从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的第19层代表物中提取出特征. 最后,我们利用GPT-6 Luna来提出有关工作角色特征模式的假设,以及GPT-6.1 Terra来调查这些模式是否存在于来自未见公司的职务说明中。
例如,数据科学家的广告更加强调机器学习模型的开发,数据分析员的广告强调报告业务业绩,机器学习工程师的广告强调在现实环境中应用已开发模型。 我们还观察到数据分析员和商业分析员广告所描述的应用程序在选定的几个月中存在差异,尽管我们数据集的规模和不均衡的覆盖范围限制了其解释。 总而言之,我们提出一个现实的应用,即SAEs和PERC对非结构化的文本数据进行应用,并审查自动化的洞察力提取如何能够支持对职务说明的人工分析。

articles.title: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
articles.content: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.

articles.title_zh: 读还是记得? 衡量语言模型中的时间污染
articles.content_zh: 语言模型现在被用来读取用于经济预测的中央银行文本,但大多数是在他们阅读的文件之后对文本进行培训的. 一个读出2021 FOMC声明的模型可能已经知道通货膨胀在2022年上升了,因此其明显的技能的一部分可以是对结果的记忆,一种测试定型污染的时间形式. 我们用FOMC的语句和从2000年到2026年的分钟来测量这个内存,将现代开放模型与时间顺序一致的模型进行比较,这些模型从固定日期之前开始只接受文字训练. 如果只问一个日期的过去GDP结果,无法知道答案的模型仍然从日期和时代的以往数据中得出最多为0.64的AUC,因此机会是错的基线。 对照这些在相同问题上的无记忆模型,大多数现代模型都记得那几年的强劲增长. 会员推论根据年代和文档类型对文件进行排序,而不是根据模型是否看到它们来评分,作为公开的预训节目中的准确计分. 在实时即时播报中,我们估计的美国GDP的每一次视差溢价都比预测的比较在宏观经济样本大小时所能发现的要小,而对于GDP或通货膨胀,都无法经受多重测试的纠正。 因此,Lookahead审计应直接对照相同物品上的无记忆模型衡量内存.

articles.title: Right Reason, Wrong Advice: Evaluating Recourse in LLM Explanations of Denied Requests
articles.content: Language models increasingly write the explanations people receive when a rule system denies their request. If several rules deny the request independently, an explanation can name a true reason and still leave the person denied after they fix it. We call the missing property recourse validity: changing what the explanation cites, without changing what was asked for, can flip the decision. We compute it exactly, and a hitting-set argument predicts from the policy alone when a correct reason fails. In six of seven rule systems ported from access control and US benefit eligibility, a single correct reason almost never gives recourse when several reasons apply. Across 20 LLMs, checks of whether the cited reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, are close to chance at spotting this failure, as the argument predicts. A strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work does spot it. Stronger and reasoning models do better but still fail on many denials with four or more independent reasons. Asking for every rule helps every open model with room to improve. Explanations of eligibility decisions should be built from the decision function and judged by whether acting on them works.

articles.title_zh: 正确理由,错误的建议:评估LLM中对被拒绝请求的解释
articles.content_zh: 当一个规则系统拒绝人们的要求时,语言模型越来越多地撰写人们得到的解释. 如果有几项规则独立地拒绝请求,解释可以说明一个真实的理由,在被否决的人修好后仍然离开. 我们称缺失的财产追索有效性:改变解释所引用的内容,而不改变要求的内容,可以推翻裁决。 我们精确地计算它,一个命中点定的论据从政策中仅预测一个正确的理由失败时. 在7个规则系统中,有6个从准入控制和美国福利资格中转出,在适用若干理由时,一个单一的正确理由几乎从未给予追索权。 在20个法学硕士中,核查所列举的理由是否正确、计算或向法学硕士法官提出询问,正如论点所预测的那样,几乎有可能发现这一失败。 一位强有力的法官问,根据解释采取行动是否可行。 更强壮的推理模式做得更好,但在许多有四个或更多独立原因的否认上仍然失败. 要求每一个规则,帮助每一个开放的模型,有改进的余地. 对资格决定的解释应依据决定职能,并根据是否根据决定采取行动来判断。

articles.title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.

articles.title_zh: 见但未说:视野-语言模型中跨图像的定位和修复比较
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)往往无法在两个图像上匹配一个点或一个对象,即使答案可以从自己的隐藏状态解码. 我们从视觉符号追踪到答题字母的这个失败,在Qune3-VL(2B-32B),InternVL3.5-8B,和Gemma-3-12B中,关于合成形状相匹配,同心点相通(HPatches),和语义相通(SPair-71k),并找到两个截然不同的出题点,一组带比较的注意头,以及一个能触及0.02%参数的修复. 两个出错点: 准确的拷贝被比较,但没有被读出. 答案-位置探测器在每一个家族中都超过了被校正的输出15到25分,因为可名和不可名的形状相同,沿着探测器的方向向下行走的答案不超过随机方向. 语义上的信件在视觉符号中存在,但从未到达答案. 一条途径:将16-32个头的交叉图像注意力再分配,并保留其质量,取出17-22分的合成精度和15-32分的HPatches精度,对随机或注意相匹配的头最多取出7分. 训练本身发现的杠杆:只有这些头的查询和关键预测才能使SPair-71k的精度提高28.3分(Qune3-VL-8B)和25.1分(InternVL3.5-8B),击败了两层相配和注意力相配的头,并转至HPatches和BLINK. 一个不受约束的全层适配器通过相同头部的注意途径其收益的21-51%,随机头部最多为7%,通过改变其读取内容(效果的83-86%)而不是其重量来完成. 每个决定规则在运行前被冻结,每个被报告的数字由独立核查脚本重编.

articles.title: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
articles.content: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching, noise dilutes, and ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of the verifier, its selection error and gap sign, together with a short saturation pilot, anticipates which phenotype a run will produce. Across nine configurations spanning two frameworks, two model vendors, two adapter sizes, three precisions, two initialisations and two seeds, the phenotypes recur, sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7, and optimistic gaps remain the steeper branch. The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. We release the testbed, the training instrumentation, and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) ported to executable oracles.

articles.title_zh: 优化验证器 获得黑盒: 在精确进程下奖励黑盒
articles.content_zh: 从可核查的奖励中吸取的强化知识继承了核查者的任何错误。 在数学和代码之外,核查者是一个代理,一个名词,一个有学识的法官或者一个手写检查器,它与真实目标之间的距离从不被衡量,因此,除了黑客之外,一个不断上升的奖励是不能告诉的. 我们创造了一个环境,使真正的奖励在程序一级完全可以计算:124 416个可执行的授权政策承认一个神谕,它列出了每一项决定的每一个最起码的充分理由。 我们把这些政策汇编成精确的流程奖励,沿着七个现实的轴线(只结果、充足、只召回、取出噪音、粗糙的分类学、 Stale 政策、 LLM 判断)使核查者退化,并在每次推出时精确的核查者得分时,对每个指标进行培训。 四相相相现. 乐观的验证者被活塞所黑:充裕代用以0.940结束,而真实的忠诚度从0.731下降到了96个被搁置出场的插曲. 唯结果核查器饱和并停止教学,噪声稀释,分级保留漏洞无所妨. 对核查人、其选择错误和空白标志进行无模型审计,加上一个简短的饱和试验,预计一个运行将产生什么样的苯基。 跨越两个框架的9个配置,两个模型供应商、两个适配器大小、三个精度、两个初始化和两个种子,酚类重复出现,所有10个复制细胞的充足性损害是正数,超过7个的两个标准错误,乐观差距仍然是更陡峭的分支。 损害程度没有复制,5起预先登记的试图解释事件的报告是在下降。 我们释放试床、训练仪器和14项真正的公共政策(锡达、OPA、守门人),

articles.title: Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.

articles.title_zh: 为西班牙政治演讲评价LLMs的文化理性和活力
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于解释,生成和调解公用语言,这使得其可靠性在政治敏感环境下尤其具有后果. 虽然情绪分析是该领域的一项共同任务,但社交媒体言论中的感人意义往往通过文化定位和务实的间接提示传递,而仅靠以标签为中心的评价并不能很好地抓住这些提示。 在本文中,我们评价LLMs在社交媒体上对西班牙政治言论进行情绪分析的力度,强调文化位置的感人解释. 我们引入了一种诊断协议,将三种独立的人类注释观点结合到Gold和Ambigious子集中,并用一个合成子集来扩展本体,这个子集由情感浮出反事实组成,通过模型-条件的迷惑和LLM-as-a-judged等标准来选择. 利用这个框架,我们比较了零发和几发催化下的专有和开口量模型,重点是人类协议条件的预测强度和反事实转变。 我们的结果显示,注释模糊和反事实扰动揭示了对原始内容的传统评价往往模糊不清的失败模式。 GPT-4.1-mini仍然是受评价模型中最稳定的,而两个较小的开放重量模型在合成扰动下降解得更明显,而少发快发只带来有限的收益. 总的来说,该文件为政治情绪分析中以稳健性为导向的评价提供了可复制的协议,为模范行为在模棱两可和情绪浮出水面的反事实下提供了经验性定性,并为西班牙社交媒体提供了一套可公开查阅的、带有 " 三向 " 人类情绪说明的数据集。

articles.title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
articles.content: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.

articles.title_zh: 程序无 判断:在精确验证下学习什么小语言模型
articles.content_zh: 当一项授权政策阻碍代理人的工具调用时,审计日志应列出迫使作出决定的事实,仅此而已。 对于一个可执行的政策来说,对于一个可假设的背景空间来说,可以精确地计算出这一最低限度的充分理由,因此一个解释会与地面的真理相对比,而不是取而代之。 我们用这个精确度来问一个模型可以从一个没有出错的核查者那里学到什么. 解释者看到一个请求和一个决定,决不是政策,而且有30个回合,可以将政策适用于被修改的请求,并询问候选人的一套事实是否足够。 Frontier Models发现只有一半时间使用这些工具的确切原因, 一句话告诉他们缩小答案, Haiku从58%升至75%。 一个4B模型在2000年的删除算法痕迹上进行了微调,在它所训练的政策上达到了92%. 老师类就是这个动作:在匹配的数据大小上,算法所培养的学生在所有三个训练种子中领导边疆所培养的一门,而两只手臂从不重叠. 学生所学的是固定的充足性检查时间表,时间表不旅行. 在它从未见过的三项公共政策中,其答案仍然足够(94%),并且不再微不足道(48%),而同一句下的Haiku在所有47个事件中都是准确的。 从精确的奖励中吸取教训,在所处位置保留准确性,并颠倒战略,从调查政策到将整个预算用于充分核查。 甲骨文使训练的效果可以辨识,但并没有使训练更好.

articles.title: Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization
articles.content: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings is a standard measure of whether online discourse is converging under generative AI. When the embeddings are mean-pooled outputs of an encoder never trained for sentence similarity, this measure mostly tracks text length. In 6.06 million Reddit comments, an uncentered DeBERTa-v3 measure had suggested that only conservative discourse broke toward homogeneity after late 2022. Truncating the same comments from 10 to 150 words raises their mean cosine by eight times the reported break. A placebo that swaps every comment for a random one of equal length reproduces 81% of the asymmetry, and a fixed-content simulation reproduces 78%. The leading principal direction carries 99.9% of raw DeBERTa homogeneity, and once length is handled the asymmetry disappears under every encoder. On 575,000 Stack Exchange answers the measure reports a post-ChatGPT homogenization of technical sites that the placebo fully reproduces, although answers grew longer. A census of 31 studies locates the risk where anisotropic encoders meet time-series or length-unequal designs. A reverse control on a well-known experiment shows that centering with renormalization can reverse a genuine effect. I propose a low-cost diagnostic protocol. Corrected measures show that the two political camps converged between 2019 and 2022 and stopped converging before ChatGPT. Cross-camp replies engage their targets more closely than same-camp replies.

articles.title_zh: 在测量同源化之前嵌入余弦测量文本长度
articles.content_zh: 变相器嵌入体之间的平均对等余弦相似性是衡量在线话语在基因AI下是否趋同的标准尺度. 当嵌入器是编码器的平均值集合输出时,从未因句子相似性而训练过,这个度量器大多会跟踪文本长度. 在606万 Reddit的评论中,一项不以人为核心的DeBERTa-v3措施表明,2022年末以后,只有保守派的言论才向同质化发展. 将同样的评论从10个到150个字截断,使其平均余弦上升了所报道的中断的8倍. 将每个评论换成等长随机的安慰剂复制了81%的不对称,固定内容模拟复制了78%. 主要方向承载了99.9%的原始DeBERTa同位素,长度一旦被处理,不对称就消失在每个编码器下. 在575,000 Stack Exchange上,测量结果报告一种ChatGPT后技术站点同源化,安慰剂完全复制,尽管答案增长得更长. 31项研究的普查确定了异同编码器满足时间序列或长度不平等设计的风险。 对一出出名的实验进行反向控制表明,以再常化为中心可以逆转出真能效应. 我提出一个低成本的诊断程序。 被纠正的措施表明,两个政治阵营在2019至2022年间会合,并在ChatGPT之前停止会合. 跨营地的答复比同一营地的答复更密切地涉及他们的目标。

articles.title: Detection-Efficient Watermarking for Vision--Language Agents via Risk-Constrained Strength Allocation
articles.content: Vision--language agents generate descriptions, decisions, and instructions that may be reused by users, downstream agents, and automated workflows, creating a need for provenance mechanisms that support content authenticity and post-deployment auditing without unnecessarily degrading response quality. We present a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that combines predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy to allocate watermark strength during decoding. A single risk penalty $λ$ exposes a continuous operating frontier, allowing deployment-time selection of a detection--quality trade-off without model retraining. At a selected operating point, mean watermark strength is reduced by approximately 59.4\% relative to fixed-strength watermarking, while perplexity change falls from 0.3634 to 0.1689 and clean/paraphrased ROC-AUC reaches 0.9552/0.9459. A matched-strength analysis shows that this advantage reflects the allocation policy rather than lower average intervention: at comparable mean strength, risk-constrained allocation achieves substantially higher ROC-AUC than fixed, entropy-only, and criticality-only policies, identifying it as detection-efficient rather than quality-dominant. We further show that threshold calibration on finite samples produces substantial false-positive-rate drift, motivating calibration variance reporting as standard practice for auditable provenance.

articles.title_zh: 通过风险限制型强力配置,为远景规划代理人进行有效的水分检测
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言代理生成用户、下游代理和自动工作流程可能重复使用的说明、决定和指示,从而需要来源机制,支持内容真实性和部署后审计,而不会不必要地降低反应质量。 我们提出了一个意识到风险的语义水标记框架,该框架将预测不确定性与零镜头多模式相关性风险代用结合起来,以便在解码过程中分配水标记强度。 单一的风险罚款(美元)暴露出一个持续运作的前沿,允许部署时间选择检测质量的取舍而不进行模式再培训。 在选定的操作点,与固定强度水分标记相比,平均水分标记强度减少约59.4×××;而复杂度变化从0.3634降到0.1689;清洁/参数ROC-AUC达到0.9552/0.9459. 相匹配的强度分析显示,这一优势反映了分配政策,而不是较低的平均干预:在可比的平均强度下,风险受限分配比固定的、仅限演算和关键度的政策要高得多,认定其为检测效率高,而不是质量主导。 我们进一步表明,有限样本的阈值校正会产生大量虚假-正率漂移,促使校正差异报告成为可审计出处的标准做法。

articles.title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
articles.content: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.

articles.title_zh: Jetriever: 将代理内存从相似性检索到工具
articles.content_zh: 一个有用的记忆不需要像它帮助回答的问题。 Jetriever根据Jev的决定分数对每个存储的内存进行排名,因其对当前问题的作用,用全池公用分来取代相似性搜索. 在InMind的125个间接平滑任务上,它把黄金交换放在84.8%的案例中第一位;匹配的BM25和MiniLM控制在索引用户转折时达到1.6%和0.0%. 20个问题比较将寻找证据与它的排名区分开来:Jev和Quen3.5 9B各以50等分排名找到90%的黄金交换,而Laya则发现30%;在一等分排名,Jev达到85%,而Quen3.5 9B达到40%. 在60个"记忆特工"Bench问题的维度-比例随机抽样上,Jetriever的四分法得分为55.4%,而ReFind在同一问题上为44.3%. Jev检索费用为每个InMind问题0.08334美元,每个MAB问题平均0.03103美元。 这些结果显示了世界知识的价值,将决定性记忆排在首位的分数,以及负担得起的全池分数.

articles.title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
articles.content: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.

articles.title_zh: 高效率的微升微升的平衡双重系数化
articles.content_zh: 重量因数化(WF)方法旨在降低模型的耐久性,内存,或两者兼而有之. 这些通常会将一个被预先训练的模型分解成两个或两个以上的因子,这些因子以较少的参数和浮点操作(FLOPs)来取来相近的原始模型权重. 然而,将较少的FLOP转化为降低耐用性在实践中对WF方法具有挑战性,因为采用的管理费用是用多个较小的矩阵取代一个大的权重矩阵。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议平衡双重系数化(BTWF),它利用因素化模型的独特结构同时降低延迟并增强学习能力. 具体来说,BTWF是在共同基础的WF设置下运行的,其中两层或多层被分解成一个共享的基础矩阵和一个分层的混合矩阵. 如果这些共享层有相同的输入(即为双胞胎),那么我们只需要执行一次共享前传,减少推论时间. 然而,双层往往大小不一,从前作中的方法往往倾向于更上一层. 相比之下,我们的方法通过将“要素平衡”(FCB)与“组合贡献平衡”(BCB)相结合,提高了绩效,“要素平衡”(FCB)确保每个共同成员在选定的因素中都有充分的代表性,而“组合贡献平衡”(BCB)则考虑下游模型效应。 此外,我们还表明,过度计量的BTWF,即某些层次的因素导致FLOP高于培训期间的原始水平,可以在试验时不增加资源的情况下提高任务绩效。 对9个基准的6个模型进行的实验表明,BTWF在计算成本相当的情况下,没有进行昂贵的微调(1-3.5%的增益),就能取得2%-6%的先进收益。

articles.title: A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
articles.content: Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.

articles.title_zh: 在注释任务中模拟人口分歧的可扩展多任务学习框架
articles.content_zh: 来自不同人口背景的注释者往往由于不同的生活经验、文化背景及其与内容的关系而系统地不同意。 当出现这种分歧时,一个集团的观点有时可能需要优先处理,因为它们具有明显的优势或对结果有更大的利害关系。 例如,在评估社交媒体帖子的毒性时,将目标群体的观点列为优先事项可能很重要。 我们建议建立一个利益攸关方-知情联合多任务学习框架,以联合模拟各说明群体之间和内部的人口分歧。 该模型使用有条件的梯度路由处理由组条件标签所诱发的痉挛,参数化支持不同任务环境下组的定制加权. SAJ-MTL通过更好地了解人口敏感含量,提高了组群在毒性检测方面的性能. 仅需要注释者团体会员信息,这比现有方法更实用,需要更多隐私入侵的个人层面注释者细节. 我们的可扩展架构在计算上也具有支持大规模部署的效率。

articles.title: Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers
articles.content: Researchers at MIT recently reported that GPT-6 Astra, a frontier large language model (LLM), can write the weights of small neural networks directly in a single reply, and can read the raw weights of small networks to say what they were trained to do. In a three-day sprint, we replicated and extended these results. Our four findings: (1) Writing weights reproduces. Astra's networks for the game Breakout scored 514, 550 and 307 (versus MIT's 517), and scored just as well on two modified versions of Breakout. Claude Opus 5.5 can also write working networks, but often runs out of output tokens. (2) What is new is translating programs into weights. Earlier models could write a good policy as code a generation before they could write network weights, and the networks the models write behave like compiled programs: two models independently decompiled Astra's Breakout network into Python matching its actions in all tested states. On classifying handwritten digits, Astra's networks scored 50% on average, below a simple classifier (82%). (3) Reading weights is mostly reading the input layer. Astra and Opus 5.5 identify which game a network plays almost perfectly, but on three new games we designed and trained ourselves, Astra recovered where things are on the board, while mostly missing how the game works. (4) Auditing from weights alone is possible but shallow. Without executing code, Astra picked out a small language model poisoned during training in 10 of 10 runs, one poisoned by extra training afterwards in 7 of 10, and a malicious adapter in 23 of 32 cases, but never identified the trigger or malicious behaviour. Open-weight models lag behind. From this early study, we conclude that LLMs can read and write small networks, but that this currently amounts to compiling hand-designed programs and reading the layout of the input layer. It is a promising but early tool for interpretability.

articles.title_zh: 复制和扩大重量空间编程:边疆 LLMS 将程序编译为重量和读取输入层
articles.content_zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员最近报告说,前沿大型语言模型(LLM)GPT-6 Astra可以将小神经网络的权重直接写入一个单个回文中,并且可以读取小网络的原始权重来表达他们受过的训练. 在为期三天的短跑中,我们复制并扩大了这些结果。 我们四个发现:(1) 书写权重复制. Astra为游戏"突围"的网络打出514分,550分和307分(对麻省理工学院的517分),并在"突围"的两个被修改的版本上同样得分. Claude Opus 5.5也可以写作工作网络,但经常会耗尽输出符. (2) 新的是将程序转化为权重。 更早的模型在写出网络权重之前可以写出作为一代人代码的好政策,而模型所写的网络表现得像被编译的程序: 两个模型独立地将Astra的"突破"网络解编为Python,在所有被测试的状态下匹配其动作. 在手写数字分类方面,Astra的网络平均得分为50%,低于简单的分类器(82%)。 (3)阅读权重多为读取输入层. Astra和Opus 5.5 识别网络玩出哪些游戏几乎完美,但在我们自己设计和训练出的三个新游戏中,Astra恢复了棋盘上的东西位置,而大部分却忽略了游戏的操作方式. (4) 仅根据权重进行审计是可能的,但很浅。 在没有执行代码的情况下,Astra在10跑中的10跑中挑出一个在训练中被毒死的小语言模型,10跑中的7跑后一个被额外训练被毒死,32起案例中有23起是恶意适配器,但从未识别出触发器或恶意行为. 开放量级模型落后. 从这个早期的研究中,我们得出结论,LLMS可以读取并写出小网络,但目前这相当于编译了手工设计的程序并读取了输入层的布局. 这是一个很有希望的早期解释工具。

articles.title: Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits
articles.content: Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [-2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval [-2.0, +0.8], and -0.8 points, interval [-2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solve the LP, but the neurons it shares with the LP solution carry most of its mean push. The outcome is that, on this model, the edit acts as a nearly constant bias along u.
