articles.title_zh: 慢慢来! 关于LP在一等反跳动编辑后的说明
articles.content_zh: 重量-空间编程通过一级编辑W'=W + u v^T的MLP输出矩阵来去除一个小推理模型的思维回路,其中u是一个回路方向并v是一个稀疏的线性程序(LP)在神经元活化上的解决办法. 我们调查是否需要LP. 我们把它取而代之: 我们取取出8个神经元, 这些神经元的活化系数是最小的, 并给予它们LP溶液所实现的推力的等分量。 在 Quen3.5-0.8B 时 在1000个问题(MATH-500和GSM8K)上排序的编辑分数为67.0%,而LP编辑分数为67.4%,未经编辑的模型分数为9.5%;在跑前宣布的5分的非绝对差值内,对接的分数为-0.4分,置信间隔为95%[-2.9,+2.1]。 在另外三个采样种子上,当剂量设定为无LP时,相差为-0.6分,相差为-2.0分,+0.8分;相差为-0.8分,相差为-2.3分,+0.6分. 该类不解LP,但其与LP溶液共用的神经元携带了它的多数正推. 结果是,在这个模型上,编辑在u身上几乎是一成不变的偏差.

articles.title: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
articles.content: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.

articles.title_zh: 具有LLM的以Rubric为基础的AES 集合:利用 LLMS 的集合对学生在关键在线理性中的反应进行分解
articles.content_zh: 学生们的反应既昂贵又费时。 此外,人的注释员容易出现偏执、疲劳和流出,这进一步限制了评级的可靠性。 已采用各种方法开发自动作文评分系统,以降低这些费用并解决与偏见有关的问题。 这些方法从早期的文字地貌系统到目前的机器学习和变压器模型,不一而足. 具体而言,大型语言模型为简化AES系统的发展提供了潜力。 然而,它们受到众所周知的限制,如幻觉和即时敏感. 这就需要探索一种混合方法的潜力,这种方法通过聚合形成来发挥各地方政府的协同作用。 我们评价LLMS的组合在将学生在经济学和医学教育中的反应分到103个标准时符合人与人之间的一致的潜力。 我们使用631个德语回复和2至5个注解员从先前进行的评估中得出相应的人评分. 我们在15个开放量级的LLMs上实验了523个以红宝石为基础的即时配置,并用Krippdondorff的α来评估它们与人类评分器的一致性,用于通知员间协议(IAA)和替代注释员测试(Alt-test). 我们的结果显示,用业绩最佳的LLM-即时配置取代一个人类评分器维持或改进了103个标准中的91个标准的IAA,而LLMs通过了90个标准的备选测试. 我们的调查结果表明,目前最先进的LLMS可以支持德国在经济学和医学教育方面的反应,减少人的工作量并促成更快的处理,同时对照人的评级进行验证仍然是必要的。

articles.title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
articles.content: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% $\to$ 82.7% and 14.3% $\to$ 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% $\to$ 90.5% and 21.9% $\to$ 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org

articles.title_zh: AuXSpec: 通过可执行的后置条件学习自动格式化程序规格
articles.content_zh: 正式的规格定义了预期的程序行为并支撑了验证,但在Lean等定理证明器中书写它们很慢,而且需要大量的专门知识,使得规格成为了正式正确代码缩放的主要瓶颈. 来自自然语言问题的自动形式化是很有希望的,然而培训规格模型需要可扩展的反馈,以了解生成的规格是否能够捕捉预期的行为. 以前的做法通过明确的证明或带有正式公文证明的单独执行的代码获得这种反馈,两者都是昂贵的. 我们引入了AuXSpec, 一种精益框架, 将声明性后置条件与可执行的后置条件对齐, 尽可能通过类解析度获得, 然后,测试案例可以通过执行来评估申报的规格,让我们利用协议作为补充学习的奖励。 使用AuXSpec,我们合成了3,037个LetCode问题,并通过关于Codeforce的专家迭代将培训扩大到19.5K个样本. 实验显示,使用执行奖励的Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.8-27B培训改进了SpecGen在AuxSpec-Test上的通过@4 0.7%到82.7%,14.3%到84.3%,27B模型的效绩超过了所有前沿模型. 根据Verina域外基准及其原始提示,两种模型都提高了7.0%至90.5%和21.9%至90.5%,并超过了VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, 开源规格模型的先行技术水平为:通行@1(47.6%对我国73.7%和84.5%)和通过@4(在通行@10对我国90.5%)。 我们公布训练有素的9B和27B型号的权重和3,037个测试案例的问题,包括300个问题AuXSpec测试基准,并附有专家审查和正确性证明,供今后评估。 模型和数据:https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. 网址:https://auxspec.org

articles.title: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
articles.content: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.

articles.title_zh: 嵌入- 映射距离指南 LLM 设想? 4 个针对未来结果的测试
articles.content_zh: 一个通俗的创意配方把现有作品的嵌入图当作一个向导:取出远离一切的点并解码为思想. 我测试了四种方法,这种距离可以引导人们思考后来出现的情况。 (1)远随机取向不是文字:以后物品不会用0.10左右的生同位素与活相接取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 无相邻的搜索以中位相差0.57和0.47写出一致的文本到内部的空隙,在20分中的15分和14分击出最接近的现有项目,但只有0.07分和0.06分到最远. (2)在以往地图的k-意指细胞上,所注册的孔分数多为跟踪细胞大小和位置;以密度为基础的3个相差分数预测出哪些细胞在机会或低于机会时增长最快(AUC 0.30至0.66),在Steam和arXiv中没有增加任何动力,专利无定论;较孤立的新Steam游戏得到略好的审查. (3) ARXIV文件的LLM续作与引用它的文件相比,与来源关系较近,在三个用户提示下,反对提案重写(gpt-4o)和2023年4-12月的论文(OLMo). Critic将这一步骤超越了无内容修订,复制到150份新论文上。 揭示出一个真正后续的标题,将想法按照后续特定方向以0.032转出,超越了修订;审查者,甲骨文和距离反馈都增加了0.13,0.08和0.34的这一回合(上限为0.46,0.46,0.70),他们的转会与修订或更长的一步是分不开的. (4) 对于按相距分级的灵感材料,没有检测出倒转的U,其预期差值是跟踪格式多于内容. 最初的测试在主要结果之后进行,后续(在两次AI-Agent审查中要求的13次)之前进行了登记;所有测试都只有当地git承诺的日期。

articles.title: Beyond Bilingual: Studying Quadrilingual Code-Switching with Conversational AI
articles.content: Multilingual speakers choose languages by topic and conversation partner. Large language models (LLMs) support these languages unequally. Research on code-switching with conversational AI has mostly examined bilingual pairs of well-resourced languages. In Curaçao and Aruba, many people use Dutch, English, Spanish, and the low-resource Creole Papiamentu/o. In a preregistered study, 42 university students held two five-minute chatbot conversations, one about university life and one about local food and culture. Surveys assessed language background, AI use, and switching comfort. 20 international students in Curaçao formed a comparison sample. Participants switched between turns and rarely mixed languages within a message. English dominated both conversations. Participants switched more often in the cultural conversation, where Papiamentu/o and Spanish rose from 15% to 24% of messages. Self-reports showed no lower comfort switching with the chatbot than with a person. Conversational agents must follow turn-by-turn language changes and handle local low-resource languages well.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Bylantics: 学习四方语码-与对话AI的交接
articles.content_zh: 多语种演讲者按话题和对话伙伴选择语言。 大语言模型(LLM)对这些语言的支持不平等. 关于与对话AI进行代码切换的研究,大多研究了双语双语资源丰富的语言. 在库拉索和阿鲁巴,许多人使用荷兰语,英语,西班牙语,以及低资源克里奥尔-帕皮阿门图/o. 在一项预先登记的研究中,42名大学生进行了两次五分钟的聊天人对话,一次是关于大学生活,另一次是关于当地食物和文化. 调查评估了语言背景、AI的使用和切换舒适性。 库拉索有20名国际学生组成了比较样本. 参与者在转弯之间互换,在信息中很少使用混合语言。 两种对话都以英语为主。 参与者在文化对话中更频繁地换乘,Papiamentu/o和西班牙语的信息从15%上升到24%。 自我报告显示,与聊天机的交换比与个人的交换更加舒适。 对话代理必须跟随回合式语言变化,妥善地处理本地低资源语言.

articles.title: Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels
articles.content: Fine-tuning a small typed decision model on one user's email labels did not clear the margin we pre-registered over a logistic regression trained on the same labels. In earlier work, about two hundred labels and a TF-IDF logistic regression had the highest point accuracy on this inbox, though not significantly above the best hosted model; we ask whether the same labels, given to a decision model, close the gap. A first registered study, on a generic 4B base with cross-validation and message type only, stayed below the baseline at every label budget (-1.8 to -7.3 points). The main study was registered before any fine-tuning run: a fixed test set of 135 emails never used for selection, LoRA adapters on the public Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B decision models, nested subsets of 50 to 587 labels, two seeds and five decision fields on a free T4 GPU. Four of its five hypotheses are refuted--two in the fine-tunes' favour--and one is confirmed for one model. On message type the 4B model misses the registered three-point margin at 400 labels (+2.6) and passes it with all 587 (+3.3); with all labels both models are above the baseline by +0.7 and +3.3 points, where one email is 0.74 points and a 95% interval is about 15 points wide, and the 4B model is clearly ahead in type macro-F1 (0.581 vs. 0.406). On the three action switches the baseline is ahead at every label budget for both models (0.931 vs. 0.904 and 0.899 mean accuracy with all labels), at under a millisecond per question against 306 and 1681 ms. The 0.8B type curve barely improves after 300 labels and then falls. The baseline never predicts the two rarest classes (7 offers and 8 spam in the training pool); the fine-tuned models find spam in some runs, not consistently across seeds. We list the explanations we did not test and say when a new attempt would be worth making. Scripts are public; weights and emails are not.

articles.title_zh: Train After You Measure: 一个用户标签的精细输入式决定模型的预注册学习曲线
articles.content_zh: 在用户的电子邮件标签上细微调整一个小的打字决定模型,并没有澄清我们预先登记的关于同一标签上训练的后勤回归的幅度。 在早先的作品中,大约200个标签和一个TF-IDF物流回归在这个收件箱上具有最高的点精度,虽然并不明显高于最佳主机模型;我们询问,给予一个决定模型的同样的标签是否缩小了缺口. 第一项登记研究是在通用的4B基础上进行的,只有交叉验证和信息类型,在每一标签预算(1.8至-7.3分)都低于基线。 主要研究是在任何微调运行前注册的:一个固定测试集,135个从未用于选择的电子邮件,公共Tev1-0.8B和Tev1-4B决定模型上的LORA适配器,50至587个标签的嵌入子集,2个种子和5个决定域在一个免费的T4 GPU上. 其5个假说中,有4个被反驳了——2个在微调中的偏好——1个被确认为一个模型. 在信件类型上,4B型在400个标签(+2.6)上错过了已注册的三分差值并全部通过587个标签(+3.3);所有标签均以+0.7和+3.3分高于基线,其中1个电子邮件为0.74分,95%的间隔为大约15分宽,4B型在宏-F1型中明显领先(0.581对0.406). 在三个动作开关上,两个型号的每个标签预算(0.931对0.904和0.899所有标签的平均精确度)的基准值都提前了,每问题在一毫秒以内,306和1681毫秒以内。 0.8B型曲线在300个标签后几乎没有改善,再下降. 基准从未预测过两个最稀有的班级(7个出场机会和8个训练池的垃圾邮件);微调模型在一些跑道中发现垃圾邮件,而不是一致地跨出种子. 我们列出我们没有测试的解释,并说何时值得作出新的尝试。 文稿公开;权重和电子邮件不公开.

articles.title: Stability-Compensated Threshold Calibration for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Large Language Models
articles.content: Large language models often produce hallucinated answers, motivating selective prediction policies that abstain on uncertain queries. However, heuristic uncertainty thresholds alone do not provide statistical control of errors among accepted predictions. Linear Expectation Constraints (LEC) reduce selection-conditioned error rate (SCER) calibration to a nonpositive expected linear-loss constraint, but the associated loss is non-monotonic in the acceptance threshold. We construct an exact counterexample under i.i.d. sampling demonstrating that LEC's empirical threshold-selection rule can violate the population SCER target. To address this risk-transfer gap, we introduce Stability-Compensated Linear Expectation Control (SC-LEC), which uses the negative linear risk of a theoretical full-data reference to compensate for threshold-selection instability. For local expansion beyond a safe anchor, we derive two finite-sample certificates: a stability-based certificate exploiting rank crossings and a direct certificate using the structure of threshold expansion to reduce conservatism. With a valid population anchor margin, our certificate conditions ensure finite-sample marginal SCER control, and independent margin certification further provides a $1-δ$ high-probability guarantee for this calibration-averaged control. Experiments on CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, and TriviaQA show useful retention gains beyond the same certified anchor, while revealing conservative behavior in small-margin regimes.

articles.title_zh: 大语言模型中选择条件风险控制的稳定性补偿阈值校正
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型经常产生幻觉解答,促使选择性的预测政策放弃不确定的询问. 然而,单凭热度不确定性阈值并不能对可接受的预测中的错误进行统计控制。 线性预期限制(LEC)将选择条件误差率(SCER)校准为非正性预期线性损失限制,但相关损失在验收阈值中为非模拟. 我们在即地采样下构建了一个确切的反实例,表明LEC的经验阈值选择规则可能违反人口SCER目标. 为解决这一风险转移差距,我们引入了稳定补偿线性预期控制(SC-LEC),利用理论全数据参考的负线性风险来补偿阈值选择不稳定。 对于超出安全锚地的局部扩张,我们获得两个有限度的抽样证书:利用等级交叉的以稳定性为基础的证书和利用阈值扩张结构减少保守主义的直接证书。 有了有效的人口锚地系数,我们的证书条件保证了有限样本的边际SCER控制,独立的边际认证为这种校准平均控制进一步提供了1-美元的高概率保证。 关于常识QA、ARC-Challenge和Trivia的实验 QA显示有用的留存收益超过同一认证锚,同时揭示出小边际制度中的保守行为.

articles.title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
articles.content: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.

articles.title_zh: 《LLM授权代理人中的隐形比阿斯集成审计地图集》
articles.content_zh: 以前的工作表明,大语言模型(LLMs)在高公开度,一次性决策情景中表现出隐含的偏见,如雇用和情报评估等. 然而,随着人们越来越多地雇用自主、LLM权力的人工智能代理人代表他们做日常工作,我们了解基于社会人口假设的隐含偏见如何在广泛的工作日决策情景中出现,这一点至关重要。 我们利用美国时间使用调查(ATUS)中的17个日常活动领域,绘制出506个决策情景图集,其中LLM -- -- 有代表不同种族、性别认同和政治意识形态的人 -- -- 表达了重大的隐含偏见。 其次,在一次多方来源审计中,500名参与者作出了8 010项二进制选择,对此,最值得进一步审查的含蓄偏颇的决定设想。 我们发现,与会者优先考虑具有广泛相关性(例如关于食物选择)的决定设想方案,这些设想方案事关重大(例如关于健康),模拟社会人口组的所有成员都作出一致决定(因为这清楚地表明了陈规定型观念)。 它们受所观察到的差距或决定情景所代表的特定ATUS领域的影响较小。 在审查其优先选择的理由时,我们发现与会者往往将差异解释为人口群体的特点,并判断这些特点是否合理,往往基于他们自己内部化的定型观念。 我们讨论建立个性化AI代理,数字双胞胎,社会模拟,以及使用众源偏见审计的影响.

articles.title: What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
articles.content: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: "你的文章是什么" "你的症状":从社交媒体演讲中估算出心理测量网络
articles.content_zh: 精神病学中的症状网络几乎完全从自我报告调查表中估算出来,这限制了对某一仪器所覆盖的症状的推断。 我们引入一个直接从社交媒体言论中解答症状的网络估计框架,并将框架应用于抑郁症和饮食障碍,第三个厌食症作为跨数据集验证. 据我们所知,我们是第一个从社交媒体文本中估算症状解开的心理测量网络,将它们与临床共同认可网络进行比较,并在独立招募的3个同时横穿2个障碍的蝎子身上复制转诊语言标记。 对于抑郁症,表达分数与BDI-II合计数相挂钩,为0.434美元,21项中有20项达到FDR意义,而分出半可靠性为0.935. 网络比较 测试检测到模式之间的边缘差异很少(边缘为3-5\%),而桥梁症状则有所不同. 对于饮食障碍,项目级结果为探索性. 识别出的语言特征在所有3个蝎子身上复制出相同的方向,它们聚集在三个构造家族中.

articles.title: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
articles.content: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 西藏OCR的可读和可读评价
articles.content_zh: 藏语的光学字符识别(OCR)主要通过字符出错率(CER)来评价. 藏语标记分音节边界但不标出单词边界,因此一个单词出错率需要分节. 本研究评价了9个识别器配置,涉及排字,木块和两个手写脚本样式,单独和组合,并报告音节和字位误差率,据我们所知,这是西藏OCR的第一个. 这些配置跨越了CTC模型,TrOCR编码器与后训练分解,以及一个视觉语言模型,每个模型在CER,音节出错率(SER)和三个分词出错率(SWER)下得分. CER主要按照较高水平的费率(Kendall $τ\geq 0.833美元)对系统进行排序,一对则以相反方式订购. 关于联合培训的效果,CER和SER在64个比较中的7个记录了相反标志的重大变化. SER不需要分机,也不需要像SWER那样在三个分机中的两个分机(0.889美元)下排序系统。 每个配置的输出也会被标记为部分语音,被注释为被命名的实体和被翻译的机器,每个结果都会被比较到参考文本中获得的结果. 作为粗略的取向,翻译为60的chrF在0.047或以下的SER和0.078或以下的话段保存为0.8,而没有出错率将达到实体保存为0.6的系统与不达到的系统区分开来.

articles.title: Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words
articles.content: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Latent Bridge: 求救而无言
articles.content_zh: 基于文本的模型协作需要大型模型在更小的模型能够使用它的取向之前生成中间响应,为推断增加大型模型的解码成本. 我们引入了 POND(Prefill-Only, No-Decode),这种方法使用被冻结的大型发送器进行预装,并使用小型接收器进行所有自旋解码. 一个可训练的桥图将发送者隐藏的状态映射到额外的注意键和值上,使接收器能够全代使用这些表示. POND还支持定期审核,发送者在审核中处理接收器的部分响应,并通过额外的预填通行证来更新其指导,同时保留接收器现有的KV缓存. 在整个推理和编码基准中,POND与来自不同模范家庭的发送者一起改进了接收者的性能. 特别是,GLM-5.3提供了与Quen3.8-Max在与Quen接收器配对时相类似的收益,支持独立培训的模范家庭之间的代表转移的有效性. POND进一步表明它有能力跨越各个领域。 在接受数学和编码任务培训时,它直接转移到一般知识任务上,而不进行额外的域特有培训. 这些结果表明,大型前沿模型预填表示可以改进小模型生成而不需要大型模型自递解码.

articles.title: LATTE-WordSeg-Lite: Multi-Granularity Thai Word Segmentation on a CPU, with a Reproducible Benchmark
articles.content: Large language models read Thai through subword tokens, without a word segmenter. Yet Thai treebanks, speech metrics and morphological resources are built on words, often at several granularities, and word boundaries resolve ambiguities that subword tokens leave open. LATTE (Lattice ATTentive Encoding) reads a text at several granularities at once, through a lattice of dictionary words, but it is a large GPU model. We distil it into LATTE-WordSeg-Lite, a CPU segmenter of 1.17M parameters that keeps the lattice as features. It outputs compounds, words and morphemes in one pass, and learns only from annotated data and text whose licences allow commercial use. To compare it with other tools, published Thai scores do not suffice, as they come from different files, splits and scorers. We therefore rebuild seven test sets from pinned sources and score twelve systems under one protocol. With the unit that fits each test set, LATTE-WordSeg-Lite scores above DeepCut on five sets, four of them from corpora that its teachers learnt from. Called line by line on one CPU thread, it runs 23 times as fast as DeepCut. We release the model, the benchmark scripts and all predictions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LATTE-WordSeg-Lite:多边形 CPU上的泰语分片,带有可复制基准
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型已读取 泰语通过子词符号,没有分词符. 然而,泰国的树库、语音测量和形态资源都建立在文字上,往往存在于几个颗粒地上,文字界限解决了子词符号留下的模糊之处。 LATTE(Lattice attentive Encoding)一次在多颗颗粒上读出一个文本,通过一行一行的字典词来读取,但它是一个大型的GPU模型. 我们把它分解成LATTE-WordSeg-Lite,一个由1.17M参数组成的CPU分节器,使花纹保持为特征. 它输出一个密码中的复合词、单词和模棱两可,并且只学习附加说明的数据和文本,其许可证允许商业使用。 为了与其他工具比较,公布的泰国分数是不够的,因为它们来自不同的文件,分数和分数. 因此,我们重建了七套来自固定来源的测试设备,并根据一项协议对12个系统进行评分。 LATTE-WordSeg-Lite的分数高于DeepCut, 在一个CPU线上逐行被叫来,运行速度是DeepCut的23倍. 我们发布模型,基准脚本和所有预测.

articles.title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Anachro Bench:评估大视野-语言模型中的历史一致性
articles.content_zh: 现有大视野语言 示范基准主要评价一般日常情况下的视觉理解,使历史与特定时代保持一致,国家在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出Anachro Bench,这是评价视觉场景历史一致性的可控歧视基准。 它包含了由从19世纪后期到20世纪初的8个国家出产的1600个图像对相,每个图像将一个原始的历史图像与一个不合时代的版本相配,包含一个无缝插入的现代物体. Anachro Bench评价了三个方面: 插入对象感知,测试模型是否检测被插入的现代对象; 时代-国家一致性,评估场景是否符合指定的时代和国家; 有条件的时代-国家一致性,仅在被插入对象被正确感知时测量一致性判断. 当一个模型认为现代物体但仍然判断该场景具有历史一致性时,就会产生错误的一致性判断。 总之,Anachro Bench揭示了插入对象感知与时代国家一致性判断之间的差距,为这种行为提供了有针对性的评价.

articles.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Linguistic Annotation
articles.content: Assessing large language models for linguistic annotation requires task-specific evaluation under documented conditions. We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface for exploring and sharing results. It records prompts, configurations and predictions, enabling comparisons of annotation quality, confidence calibration, repeatability and estimated cost. We demonstrate the framework and the associated methodology through 293 runs of 48 models on nine linguistic annotation tasks spanning morphology, syntax, semantics, discourse-pragmatics, spelling normalization and learner-language correction. Models achieve high agreement with reference annotations on several tasks, including those on non-standardized, historical varieties as well as requiring contextual interpretation. The results support evaluating models against specific linguistic tasks, rather than relying on general rankings. To this end, we make the current and future benchmarks publicly available at dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语文说明大语文模型基准
articles.content_zh: 评估用于语言注释的大型语言模型需要在有文件记载的条件下进行针对具体任务的评价. 我们提出dhAI Bench,这是一个Python基准和注释工具,有一个网页界面,用于探索和分享结果。 它记录了提示、配置和预测,从而能够对注释质量、信心校准、可重复性和估计费用进行比较。 我们通过涉及9个语言注释任务的293个模型展示了框架和相关方法,这些模型涉及形态学、语法、语义学、语法学、拼写正常化和学习者语言校正。 模型就若干任务,包括非标准化的历史品种和需要背景解释的任务,达成了高度一致的参考说明。 结果支持对照特定语言任务评价模型,而不是依赖一般排名. 为此,我们在dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz公布目前和未来的基准。

articles.title: Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models
articles.content: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 古典结构前科改进了分子语言模型中的神经分子表现
articles.content_zh: 古典分子相似性是化学信息系统的核心,然而在成对结构-文本数据上被训练的分子语言模型并不一定根据分级结构关系组织分子嵌入. 在这里,我们引入了结构-智能引导对接器(SAGA),这是一种仅培训的规范化器,它使用中枢克内尔对接使神经分子表达与以指纹为基础的Tanimoto相似性一致,而不增加参数,也不在推断时需要指纹. 在MOLCA和Atomas中,SAGA改进了分子-文本检索,将非精确检索转向更紧密的结构模拟,并增加了平均脚手架-分解属性-预测性能,而分子描述和文本-分子生成则被改进或保存在单运行的活化中. 这些结果表明,既定的化疗信息学前科可以使分子语言表达在保持其多式效用的同时更具有化学上的忠实.

articles.title: The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning
articles.content: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\llκ\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 选择实例的价格:适应性内在学习中环境的过度适应
articles.content_zh: 通常在选择学习者之前,就对内容内学习进行分析,仿佛对提示中的例子进行了抽样。 在部署的系统中,它们不是:实例被检索、过滤、重新排序、编辑,并在看到查询和数据库后反复测试。 我们通过有条件的分泌-内核微积分,将快速构建视为适应性数据分析,从而将这一差距正式化。 我们的主要数量是数据存储和最后及时记录之间的上下文容量、相互信息或大致最大信息。 对于任何被冻结的文字学习者以及任何具有美元能力的适应性环境管道,我们证明一种有限-实例的上下文概括,以$\sqrt%/k}美元为限,其中以美元作为选定实例的数量,其损失构成报告的得分。 我们证明一个匹配的下限, 当 $\log k\llκ\ll k$ 时它的常数是准确的, 并得出两个 PAC- Bayesian 检索规则: 一阶 Gibbs 规则, 要求依赖数据的候选者打开其先前的质量, 以及自常态的 二阶规则 。 在有64个检索食谱和两个模型家族的Banking77上,证书在所有24 000个再模拟选择活动中都持有,从64个(Quen2.5-7B)或128个(GPT-4.1-mini)再利用验证中询问Gibbs规则证明在99%以上的验证抽取中低于零发误差的风险。 最后,我们即时分析贝叶斯线性内文回归的理论,包括对查询相通的上-美元高斯检索的顺序-统计分析. 结果将上下文质量与上下文认证区分开来:只有当选择上下文的程序足够稳定,可供选定上下文证据转移时,长期或更相关的上下文才会增加风险.

articles.title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
articles.content: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 信仰流:通过晚期信仰动态激发集体情报
articles.content_zh: 在这项工作中,我们认为多代理人推理是寻求隐含信仰动态的集体平衡并引入信仰流(Sequence of Secret)的过程,在这个过程中,代理人保持了持续的潜伏信仰并反复地通过沟通和反思来加以完善. 我们的方法寻求一种多代理系统的集体信念状态,在这种体系中,进一步的交流不会导致有意义的信息传播。 通过广泛的实验,我们展示了SoB跨任务和模范家庭的通俗化. 更广泛地说,我们的成果提出了从信仰动态中扩大多代理推理的新观点。

articles.title: Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
articles.content: Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.

articles.title_zh: 任何适应性测试-时间放大的 Valid PAC-Bayes 证书
articles.content_zh: 测试时间缩放系统经常选择采样量,采样时提示使用,在反复检查校正集后,哪个校验或汇总规则可以信任. 标准验证错误栏在此适应性选择后无效. 我们模拟一个测试时间缩放的食谱作为随机化的预测器,随机成本,并证明一个时相统一的PAC-Bayes证书,它同时保存在所有校准时间,所有后相混合于食谱,以及所有依赖数据的停止规则. 因此,同一事件涵盖部署前的食谱搜索,而不仅仅是最后报告的固定食谱。 对于有限的预算网格和核查者,惩罚是熟悉的$\log M/n$,在最糟糕的情况下,选择后有效的证书无法避免,而非统一前科和本地化后相混合物可以为结构化搜索提供更尖锐的证书. 我们把结果专用于自我一致性,并显示一个互补比值法:多元投票在样本预算中只针对正确答案是生成器唯一模式的例子而成指数性地提高;否则,比较计算可以证明可以放大错误. 同样的差值分析得出了用于计算分配的甲骨文取水法。 一项综合审计量化了因适应性预算选择而带来的乐观情绪,一项192-例的GSM8K审计使用gpt-4.1-miny代说明真实推论管道的风险成本报告。 在规模上,在GSM8K和MATH-500上有两个型号,所选最佳出错条以名义上5%的任意分出而证书从未分出,在完整的GSM8K测试上被分出后收紧到0.109(控出风险0.039). 结果提供了一种轻量级、无分布的方法,用以报告风险并计算适应性推断系统的索赔。

articles.title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
articles.content: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

articles.title_zh: 通过公开渠道的真实证据,可以操纵语言模型代理人的信仰
articles.content_zh: 语言模型代理人的信仰可以通过社交媒体等开放渠道被操纵,即使他们得到的信息是真实的. 当代理人填补自发关系的碎片之间的空白时,他们可能接受这些关系为既定事实,并将由此产生的谣言传递给他人. 我们借鉴蒙太奇的叙事理解和电影理论的认知理论,引入了Generative Montage,通过协调代理人将真实的片段整理成误导性的叙事,将这种称为叙事过度搭配的失败付诸实施. 超过1090个来自6个推特事件的传言目标, 在多数投票或审查相同证据后,接受率仍然超过50%,这表明错误如何可以导致下游决定。 为了解释这种易感性,零敲碎打的干预措施确定了影响完整叙述中信仰的帖子。 然后合成控制显示类似的反应模式出自有效的证据,将信仰影响和证据支持区分开来. 这种区分激发了“基础监测”这一概念的证明神经-症状运行时间监测器,该监测器检查直接的证据支持,以指导代理人的判断,使决定准确度在原始和匿名环境中提高了5.6至29.0个百分点。 这些调查结果暴露出一种认知途径,即传出谣言放大,支持监测在代理人产生的结论指导公共决策之前推断出的关系.

articles.title: A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications
articles.content: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.

articles.title_zh: 用于全家智能服务的基因化AI-Driven架构:边缘模型、记忆管理和家庭应用
articles.content_zh: 基因人工智能正进入家中. 以云为基础的助手在数据传输,持续可用,以及物理动作的可靠性方面面临治理限制,在设备仍然在线,数据随时间而积累,命令触发现实世界行动的家庭中尤为突出. 本条以家用本地服务器为统一组织轴线,制定以设计为导向的审查框架. 从arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, 和官方文件的来源被搜索到2026年11月,并被编码为五个证据类别:审查,系统原型,基准,HCI和老年人护理研究,以及官方文件. 系统设计被映射到共享的建筑模块上,确定了本地服务器的9个经常性责任。 基因模型支持概念解释、意向理解和候选人规划,而确定性验证、知识图约束和授权租赁则将候选人行动局限于可检查的空间。 家庭控制,情感伴侣关系,以及智能守护等,可以在一个共同框架内进行比较:它们共享状态和记忆,但在耐久性,假正负率,活性,和权限方面却有所不同. 现有基准依靠虚拟环境,不能取代实际部署评价。 当地部署本身并不更加安全,仅靠技术连续性并不能确定陪伴和看守的社会或医疗影响。 文章提出了涵盖建筑能力,系统资源,隐私,安全和可靠性,以及人类经验的五维评价框架,同时提出了六条设计原则和本地第一智能家庭系统的未来研究议程.

articles.title: Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence
articles.content: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. These findings demonstrate learnable confidence-related granularity adaptation, with benefits varying by model.

articles.title_zh: 教学语言模型以适应其信任度
articles.content_zh: 当精确的细节不确定时,收紧的回答可以保留有用的信息而无需猜测或弃权. 我们调查语言模型是否能够通过从不同颗粒度层次的抽样反应的一致性和对答案的识别中得出的具有模型条件的监督来学习这种行为. 我们评价了LFM2.5-1.2B、Monistal~3~3B、Quen3.5-9B和Gemma~4~31。 关于时间和地理问题的B和三个概括数据集。 在一些域内设置中,微调可以改善正确性和信息性的平衡,超越了将基础答案压缩到最佳固定水平. 纵观通论数据集,所有四个模型都比起高基模型的置信度,更经常地产生相近的回答. 在共同考虑正确性和颗粒性时,三个较小的模型的答案也比搁置关系的基本答案更为可取。 这些调查结果表明,与信心有关的颗粒性适应是可学习的,其效益因模式而异。

articles.title: Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education
articles.content: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.

articles.title_zh: 验证基于 LLM 的 Essay 评分:医学教育关键在线理由的比较分析
articles.content_zh: 基于大型语言模型(LLMS)的自发作文分数员(AES)承诺了人类层面的准确性. 然而,培训、微调和评价用于具体评估任务的法学硕士课程费用高昂。 特别是,问题是,这些AES是否应当为具体领域提供培训,或者基于通用有限责任公司的模式是否足够。 相比之下,人类的说明往往更有效,但费用要高得多。 本研究评价了基于通用LLMS的AES系统群集是否能够通过利用编码语言和概念知识来大致评价人类对医学教育写作任务的评级. 目的是评估通用模型是否适用于在这一领域协助或可能取代人的注释。 我们试验了11个AES系统和8个不同的LLM,并评价668个学生对12个任务的反应,使用\numprint{2076} 由7个人类注释员的评价. 对这些评级进行汇总,以创造一致的业绩水平,作为接受过AES产出培训的分类人员的目标类别。 我们的结果显示,基于人类评级的学习者课程可以精确地重建,使用一个线性SVM训练,以一套小的AES特征. 一个单一的分类器对任务和领域作了很好的概括,推理和内容特征最具有预测性。 这表明出局的LLMS即使没有特定域的微调,也能支持医学教育中的自动作文分级. 虽然单靠单个的AES系统是不够的,但它们的组合与人类评价人员相近,表明人工评分或用自动化方法补充的必要性有所减少。

articles.title: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
articles.content: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.

articles.title_zh: 见不是解:视觉和语言上的分歧与对话地平线
articles.content_zh: 视底基准通常不考虑现实世界情景的背景不确定性。 在这项研究中,我们构建了一个新的基准,即日本对“与对话相伴”的视觉定位数据集的评估。 它包括人-机器人对话的多模式互动,涵盖视觉和语言类别产生的不同类型的模糊。 我们评价不同最先进的视觉语言模型(VLMs)识别和解析的能力. 我们比较了作为视觉和语言模糊性分辨率基础的对话背景。 我们的实验表明,VLMs可以通过使用对话上下文来大幅度地改善语言模糊度的解析,特别是日本的零角草. 我们进一步进行了比较分析,以了解对话的语义内容或对话结构是否带来根本性的改进。

articles.title: TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System
articles.content: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.

articles.title_zh: TRACK:电力管理系统断层诊断时间序列工具强化理由
articles.content_zh: 运行多负荷的电力管理系统的故障诊断依赖于专家手动检查电流和电压波形,这些波形未能在所部署的单位之间扩大. 我们提出TRACK,它将一个时间序列编码器与一个"小语言"模型相配,以产生结构化的,基于物理的诊断报告,呼吁使用精确,可核查的计算工具. 它在设备上运行,将专有传感器数据保存在本地并避免昂贵的API呼叫. 我们提出一个基于标题的框架,通过评分结构、信号忠贞性、物理推理、诊断和可操作性来评价这些报告。 在一个15级多负荷模拟基准上,TRACK实现了95%以上的断层分类精确度,并概括到分配外断层,而最佳编码-测试基准仅达到58%的精确度.

articles.title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
articles.content: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.

articles.title_zh: PlainPairs:美国处方药标签处方和患者文本的配对
articles.content_zh: 美国的处方药带有给处方医生写作的标签,许多药品也带有给病人写作的文字:"药物指南"或"病人包"插入. 这两个文本为两位读者描述了同一种医学,然而公共资源却很少将两者并存. 我介绍PlainPairs,一个从开FDA药物标签文件所建的开封体. 0.1.0版本有35 177个处方标签,上面有病人的文本,21 416个不同的病人文本,250 829个病人文本部分,通过规范标题、双方的阅读水平措施以及基于规则的简单语言措辞计数,与处方部分相匹配。 第二个来源是国家癌症研究所的癌症信息摘要,增加了756个英文和西班牙文保健专业和病人摘要。 根据标签结构衡量,Flesch-Kincaid在8.7年级读取了中位医学指南,SMOG在11.1年级读取了该指南。 在平版文本上测得的同一份指南,即散装文件读取的音高约两等,这一差异来自丢失的列表和标题边界. 病人的文本每100句中有41句针对读者,而处方部分为0.2句. 盲手检查出100对,支持对十种标题类型中的七种进行以标题为主的对齐. 委托书、其代码和文件是公开的,发行时保留了显示公司版权标记的文本。

articles.title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
articles.content: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-recommendation.

articles.title_zh: 编辑建议: LLMS 是否可编辑用户的请求, 以及何时?
articles.content_zh: 在大型语言模型(LLM)代理生成出一件文物后,用户经常会为它发送编辑请求. 本文研究了LLM在发出这些请求之前是否能够预见到这些请求. 这种预期在实践中是有用的,因为它减少了用户审查和反馈的努力。 我们正式确定这项任务为编辑建议并构建EditRec Bench,这是从WildChat-4.8M中的现实世界对话日志来评价LLMs在这项任务上的表现的基准. 通过基准和失败分析,我们查明了一个实际挑战,即一些案例在现实环境中本来就难以预测。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了基于决策模型的标注法,在向用户提出预测之前,过滤出预测不大可能正确的情况。 我们训练有素的模型超越了现有的决策模型,并在显示的建议中将通过"5"提升到12-25分的比分. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-advision上查到。

articles.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
articles.content: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.

articles.title_zh: 从仓库到培训环境:用环境进化循环放大长视距编码代理
articles.content_zh: 长视距任务的培训编码员需要具备可核查反馈的环境. 现有的管道往往遵循一个线性过程,以验证结束,确定可用性,但对提高培训价值却很少提供指导。 递归自修(RSI)往往需要模式推出或模式培训,然后进行下游评价,成本和反馈延迟在长距离任务上被放大. 我们如何利用及时,可靠的代理信号来提高训练价值并大规模地综合环境? 我们提出RepoFactory,一个自动管道,将真实的寄存器转换成可核查的环境,通过语言规格从头开始构建完整的项目. 其"环境进化循环"通过代理反馈,优化了结合有效性,结构耦合和执行范围的多功能目标. RepoFactory在17个软件领域产生10,159个环境. 关于这些环境的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B培训产生了RepoHorizen-35B-A3B,在NL2Repo-Bench上取得了22.6%的增益,在现实世界生产环境中涵盖长距离编码和代理任务的5个基准上平均获得了8.5分,而在没有环境演化的情况下则取得了17.5分和6.4分. 这些成果突出了RepoFactory环境的培训价值以及环境进化循环带来的额外收益.

articles.title: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
articles.content: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.

articles.title_zh: SWE-What 如果: 从录制的会话模拟编码代理的真实用户
articles.content_zh: 用户和编码代理之间录制的会话提供了一个评估代理如何完成现实世界的任务并与用户互动的方法. 然而,这些会话不能简单地用新代理重放,因为当代理采取不同的轨迹时,记录的用户回复可能不再适用. 我们介绍 SWE-What If,它通过模拟用户的意图,满足的标准,以及产生这些目的的条件,与新代理重播录制的会话. 使用这个模型,一个用户模拟器生成的回复会适应不见的代理转折,而同时又被固定在录音中. 在89个现实世界会议上,SWE-What如果生成的答复与实际用户的答复最相类似,并匹配重写会议时最强的基准。 为了测试适应性,我们与被指示避免或重复被记录的用户所后推的动作的代理重放会话. SWE-What如果产生了避免这些行动的最高赢取率(66.3%),大大高于机会。 我们进一步证明了它的效用,将5个LLMs列为编码代理,其中排名最高的模型取决于用户如何说明并发展出他们的意图,还有一项有16个用户参与的研究,其中重播自己的会话改变了14位参与者的排名并告知了他们未来的代理用途.
